spiderfoot.name: spiderfoot
spiderfoot.text: spiderfoot spiderfoot open-source osint automation framework that integrates 200+ data sources to build comprehensive intelligence profiles on domains, ips, emails, usernames, and organizations. supports both passive and active collection modes with a web-based interface. spiderfoot 是一款開源情報(osint)自動化工具,整合了幾乎所有可用的資料來源,可自動化地對目標進行全面的情報收集。 spiderfoot is an open source intelligence (osint) automation tool. automation recon domain ip email open-source website username email ip collected leads or relationship views; validate each underlying source. 彙整線索或關係視圖;需逐項核實底層來源。 domain ip email person organization passive reconnaissance on a suspicious domain — auto-aggregates dns, whois, ip reputation email address investigation — traces linked social accounts and breach records corporate attack-surface mapping — discovers exposed subdomains and services 對可疑網域進行被動偵察 — 自動彙整 dns、whois、ip 信譽資料 電子郵件地址調查 — 追蹤關聯的社群帳號與資料外洩記錄 企業攻擊面映射 — 發現暴露的子網域與服務

maltego.name: maltego
maltego.text: maltego maltego visual link-analysis platform for osint and digital forensics. maps relationships between people, organizations, domains, ips, and social accounts through an interactive graph interface. industry-standard tool for complex network investigations. maltego 是一款開源情報與數位鑑識應用程式,提供視覺化的關聯分析介面,能夠快速挖掘並呈現人員、組織、網域、ip 等實體之間的關係圖譜。 maltego is an open source intelligence and forensics application. visualization graph recon network forensics website username email ip collected leads or relationship views; validate each underlying source. 彙整線索或關係視圖;需逐項核實底層來源。 person organization domain ip email social-media map an organization's infrastructure — discover domain, ip, and asn relationships trace social media account connections to identify associated persons visualize threat-actor attack infrastructure in digital forensics investigations 映射組織的基礎設施 — 發現網域、ip 和 asn 之間的關聯關係 追蹤社群媒體帳號連結以識別關聯人員 在數位鑑識調查中視覺化威脅來源的攻擊基礎設施

shodan.name: shodan
shodan.text: shodan shodan internet-of-things search engine that continuously scans and indexes all internet-connected devices — servers, cameras, industrial control systems, routers — with full service banners and vulnerability data. essential for exposure assessment and infrastructure intelligence. shodan 是全球首個針對連網裝置的搜尋引擎,可搜尋暴露在網路上的伺服器、攝影機、工業控制系統、路由器等裝置,是網路情報分析與攻擊面評估的核心工具。 shodan is the world's first search engine for internet-connected devices. iot network ip vulnerability search-engine ip website indexed service observations that may be historical. 已索引的服務觀察,可能是歷史資料。 ip network domain organization find all internet-exposed services for a target organization to assess attack surface search for publicly exposed industrial systems or misconfigured cameras track global exposure of a specific cve vulnerability across hosting providers 尋找目標組織所有暴露於網際網路的服務以評估攻擊面 搜尋公開暴露的工業控制系統或配置錯誤的監視器 追蹤特定 cve 漏洞在各雲端託管商的全球暴露情況

whatsmyname.name: whatsmyname
whatsmyname.text: whatsmyname whatsmyname candidate account pages or public account context, not verified identity. 候選帳號頁面或公開帳號背景,並非已核實身份。 this tool allows to enumerate usernames across many websites. username social-media enumeration passive-recon username candidate account pages or public account context, not verified identity. 候選帳號頁面或公開帳號背景,並非已核實身份。 username person social-media check a username across hundreds of platforms in one query build a starting list of confirmed social accounts for a person of interest detect impersonation accounts using a known handle on unexpected platforms 在一次查詢中檢查特定使用者名稱在數百個平台上的存在情況 為特定調查對象建立已確認社群帳號的初始清單 偵測在未預期平台上使用已知帳號名稱的冒牌帳號

theHarvester.name: theharvester
theHarvester.text: theharvester theharvester command-line osint tool that harvests email addresses, subdomains, hosts, and employee names from public sources including google, bing, linkedin, and shodan. widely used in the reconnaissance phase of security assessments. theharvester 是一款命令列 osint 工具,可從多種公開資料來源自動收集電子郵件地址、子網域與員工姓名,常用於滲透測試的前期偵查階段。 e-mails, subdomains and names harvester. osint tool. email subdomain recon harvesting open-source website company email published contact or infrastructure leads; check provenance. 公開聯絡或基礎設施線索;核對出處。 email domain organization person automatically collect employee email addresses from public data before a security assessment enumerate all discoverable subdomains and hosts for a target domain aggregate multiple open-source intelligence feeds to build an initial target profile 在安全評估前從公開數據中自動收集員工電子郵件地址 列舉目標網域的所有可探測子網域和主機 彙整多個開源情報源以建立初始目標檔案

intelx.name: intelligencex
intelx.text: intelligencex intelx deep search engine indexing leaked datasets, dark web content, tor sites, telegram channels, and archived snapshots. useful for tracing breach exposure, finding deleted content, and researching threat actors. free tier provides limited results. intelligencex 是一個付費搜尋引擎,可查詢資料洩露檔案、暗網內容、tor 網站及歷史快照,是調查資料洩露事件與暗網活動的重要資源。 search engine for leaked data, dark web content, and historical snapshots. dark-web leaks search-engine historical email website person company indexed candidate records; coverage and paid access vary. 已索引的候選記錄;涵蓋範圍與付費存取条件不同。 email username domain organization person search a target email or username for exposure in known breach datasets investigate dark-web forum discussions mentioning a target organization retrieve historical snapshots of websites that have since been taken offline 搜尋目標電子郵件或使用者名稱在已知資料外洩數據集中的暴露情況 調查暗網論壇中提及目標組織的討論內容 檢索已下線網站的歷史快照

censys.name: censys
censys.text: censys censys internet-wide scanning platform providing continuous data on all internet-exposed hosts, tls certificates, and websites. useful for discovering an organization's full exposure footprint through certificate transparency logs and service banners. censys 是一款專注於網際網路設備與憑證掃描的搜尋引擎,提供對全球主機、網站及憑證的持續性掃描資料,廣泛用於攻擊面管理與資安合規評估。 censys is a search engine that allows computer scientists to ask questions about the devices and networks that compose the internet. network ip tls certificates search-engine api ip website indexed service observations that may be historical. 已索引的服務觀察,可能是歷史資料。 ip domain network organization search all tls certificates issued for a target organization to discover unlisted subdomains analyze service configurations and security posture for a specific asn or ip range monitor an organization's public exposure and identify unauthorized or expired services 搜尋為目標組織核發的所有 tls 憑證以發現未列出的子網域 分析特定 asn 或 ip 範圍的服務配置與安全狀態 監控組織的公開暴露情況,並識別未授權或過期的服務

osint-framework.name: osint framework
osint-framework.text: osint framework osint-framework visual taxonomy of osint tools organized by investigation target type. displays hundreds of free tools in an interactive tree, making it the fastest starting point for identifying which tools to use for a given investigation objective. osint framework 是一個視覺化的 osint 工具目錄,以樹狀圖方式整理數百個免費情報工具,按調查目標類型分類,是情報分析師快速尋找合適工具的入門導覽資源。 osint framework focused on gathering information from free tools or resources. directory reference free-tools taxonomy question a resource taxonomy to explore; individual links require checking. 可探索的資源分類;個別連結需要核對。 person email phone username domain ip social-media organization quickly find available tools for a specific target type — phone, social media, domain introduce new analysts to the osint tool ecosystem as a reference overview plan a tool chain before starting an investigation to ensure complete coverage 快速尋找適用於特定目標類型(電話、社群媒體、網域等)的可用工具 為新進分析師介紹 osint 工具生態系統作為參考指引 在開始調查前規劃工具鏈以確保覆蓋完整

chiasmodon.name: chiasmodon
chiasmodon.text: chiasmodon chiasmodon domain-focused osint tool that aggregates associated emails, credentials, cidr ranges, asns, subdomains, and even google play app ids linked to a target domain. useful for deep organizational footprinting beyond standard dns enumeration. chiasmodon 是一款針對網域情報收集的 osint 工具,可搜尋網域關聯的電子郵件、憑證、cidr、asn 與子網域,適合針對特定組織進行深度網域調查。 chiasmodon is an osint tool designed to assist in the process of gathering information about a target domain. domain email subdomain credentials open-source website username email ip collected leads or relationship views; validate each underlying source. 彙整線索或關係視圖;需逐項核實底層來源。 domain email network organization collect all email addresses and credential leaks associated with a target domain enumerate cidr ranges and asns linked to the organization's network topology track mobile apps published by the target organization on google play 收集與目標網域關聯的所有電子郵件地址與憑證洩露記錄 列舉與組織網路拓撲連結的 cidr 範圍與 asn 追蹤目標組織在 google play 上發布的行動應用程式

haveibeenpwned.name: have i been pwned
haveibeenpwned.text: have i been pwned haveibeenpwned exposure or candidate account signals; these do not identify the current owner. 外洩或候選帳號訊號;不能確認目前使用者。 check if your email has been compromised in a data breach. email breach password monitoring email exposure or candidate account signals; these do not identify the current owner. 外洩或候選帳號訊號;不能確認目前使用者。 email phone person quickly confirm whether a target email appeared in known breach databases assess historical account exposure risk during a phishing investigation monitor an organization's domain email addresses for breach appearances 快速確認目標電子郵件是否出現在已知的外洩資料庫中 在網路釣魚調查期間評估歷史帳號的暴露風險 監控組織網域內的電子郵件地址是否出現在外洩事件中

recon-ng.name: recon-ng
recon-ng.text: recon-ng recon-ng modular osint reconnaissance framework with a metasploit-like interface. features a marketplace of modules for automated data collection from dns, social platforms, and search engines. suitable for analysts who need structured, repeatable collection workflows. recon-ng 是一款模組化的開源情報收集框架,介面類似 metasploit,提供豐富的模組可自動化從 dns、社交媒體、搜尋引擎等來源收集資訊,適合有一定技術背景的滲透測試人員。 open source intelligence gathering tool aimed at reducing the time spent harvesting information from open sources. automation recon framework modular open-source website username email ip collected leads or relationship views; validate each underlying source. 彙整線索或關係視圖;需逐項核實底層來源。 domain organization person email automate dns and network information gathering using a modular workflow integrate multiple apis (shodan, virustotal) for systematic reconnaissance export collected intelligence directly into a reporting pipeline 使用模組化工作流程自動收集 dns 和網路資訊 整合多個 api(shodan、virustotal 等)進行系統化偵察 將收集的情報直接匯出到報告管道中

google-dorks.name: google dorks / ghdb
google-dorks.text: google dorks / ghdb google-dorks community database of advanced google search queries (dorks) that surface misconfigured or exposed resources — login pages, sensitive files, error messages, and open directories. a reference library for passive web intelligence gathering. google hacking database(ghdb)是一個收錄大量 google 進階搜尋語法(dork)的資料庫,可用於發現暴露的敏感文件、登入頁面、未授權資料庫等。 google hacking database: a database of google search queries that expose sensitive information. google-dorking search-engine passive-recon vulnerability query a search-query collection; it is not a name lookup service. 搜尋語句集,並非姓名查詢服務。 domain organization document locate exposed sensitive configuration files on a target domain using precise search operators search for default login pages on specific technology stacks during an authorized assessment find accidentally indexed internal documents exposed via search engines 使用精確的搜尋運算子定位目標網域上暴露的敏感配置檔案 在獲授權的評估期間,搜尋特定技術棧上的預設登入頁面 尋找經搜尋引擎意外索引而暴露的內部文件

exiftool.name: exiftool
exiftool.text: exiftool exiftool file metadata that may be missing or altered. 可能缺失或被修改的檔案中繼資料。 read, write and edit meta information in image and other file types. metadata image geolocation exif forensics open-source image document video file metadata that may be missing or altered. 可能缺失或被修改的檔案中繼資料。 image document geolocation person extract gps coordinates from an uploaded image to determine the shoot location analyze document metadata to identify author names, software, and modification history verify a photograph's claimed origin by cross-checking timestamps and device fingerprints 從上傳的圖片中提取 gps 座標以確定拍攝位置 分析文件後設資料(metadata)以識別作者姓名、軟體和修改歷史 透過交叉比對時間戳記和裝置指紋,驗證相片所聲稱的來源

sherlock.name: sherlock
sherlock.text: sherlock sherlock candidate account pages or public account context, not verified identity. 候選帳號頁面或公開帳號背景,並非已核實身份。 hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks. username social-media enumeration open-source username candidate account pages or public account context, not verified identity. 候選帳號頁面或公開帳號背景,並非已核實身份。 username person social-media search a username across hundreds of platforms to confirm account presence track a scammer or harasser's cross-platform activity trail build a social media account inventory for a missing person or suspect 在數百個平台上搜尋特定使用者名稱以確認帳號是否存在 追蹤詐騙者或騷擾者的跨平台活動軌跡 為失蹤人員或嫌疑人建立社群媒體帳號清單

comb.name: comb lookup
comb.text: comb lookup comb web interface to query the comb (combination of many breaches) dataset — one of the largest compiled breach collections. returns whether an email address appears in the aggregated dataset. use only to assess your own or authorized accounts. comb(combination of many breaches)是目前規模最大的憑證洩露資料集查詢工具,收錄超過 32 億筆電子郵件與密碼組合,可用於確認目標帳號是否存在已知憑證洩露。 the largest dataset of leaked credentials. credentials breach email password lookup email exposure or candidate account signals; these do not identify the current owner. 外洩或候選帳號訊號;不能確認目前使用者。 email username person check whether an email address appears in large-scale aggregated breach collections identify possible credential sources during an account takeover investigation assess employee account exposure on corporate domains 檢查電子郵件地址是否出現在大規模彙整的資料外洩集合中 在帳號被盜調查中,識別可能的憑證洩漏來源 評估企業網域內員工帳號的暴露風險

pimeyes.name: pimeyes
pimeyes.text: pimeyes pimeyes commercial facial recognition reverse-image search engine. upload a face photo to discover where that person appears elsewhere online. used in identity verification, missing person cases, and detecting unauthorized use of profile photos. pimeyes 是一款商業人臉辨識搜尋引擎,可透過上傳人臉圖片在網路上搜尋包含相同人臉的其他圖片,廣泛用於尋找失蹤人員、確認人員身分,或調查未授權使用他人照片的情況。 pimeyes is an online face search engine. face-recognition image person reverse-image image candidate matching images and source pages; compare dates and context. 候選相似圖片與來源頁;比較日期與上下文。 person image upload a face photo to discover other public images of the same person investigate stolen profile photos used by fake social media accounts assist in missing person cases by searching for online activity traces 上傳人臉相片以搜尋同一個人在網路上的其他公開影像 調查虛假社群媒體帳號所使用的盜用大頭貼 透過搜尋網路活動軌跡,協助調查失蹤人員案件

wigle.name: wigle
wigle.text: wigle wigle crowdsourced database mapping the physical locations of wi-fi access points and mobile base stations globally. search by ssid or mac address to retrieve historical geolocation data. useful for device tracking and wireless security research. wigle 是一個收錄全球無線網路位置資料的資料庫,透過眾包方式建立 wifi 熱點與行動網路基地台的地理位置地圖。 wireless network mapping and geolocation database. wifi geolocation network mapping location map, imagery or location clues; check capture date and multiple landmarks. 地圖、影像或地點線索;核對拍攝日期與多個地標。 geolocation network person look up the historical geolocations of a specific wi-fi ssid or mac address corroborate a subject's historical presence in a location using wireless network records analyze wi-fi density and network security configurations in a geographic area 查詢特定 wi-fi ssid 或 mac 地址的歷史地理位置 使用無線網路記錄佐證調查對象在某處的歷史活動足跡 分析特定地理區域的 wi-fi 密度和網路安全配置

lampyre.name: lampyre
lampyre.text: lampyre lampyre commercial osint data analysis platform with a unified interface for dozens of data sources. provides graph-based visualization and relationship mapping for people, organizations, phone numbers, and emails — suited for analysts who need an all-in-one paid workstation. lampyre 是一款商業 osint 資料分析工具,提供統一介面整合數十個資料來源,支援視覺化分析與關係圖譜,適合需要在單一平台完成資料收集、可視化與分析的專業調查人員。 data analysis & osint tool. visualization analysis commercial all-in-one website username email ip collected leads or relationship views; validate each underlying source. 彙整線索或關係視圖;需逐項核實底層來源。 person organization phone email domain integrate multiple sources in one platform for comprehensive background research visualize complex relationships between persons, companies, and phone numbers conduct multi-dimensional data cross-analysis for financial fraud investigations 在單一平台中整合多個來源以進行全面的背景調查 視覺化人員、公司與電話號碼之間的複雜關係 為金融詐欺調查進行多維度數據交叉分析

tookie-osint.name: tookie-osint
tookie-osint.text: tookie-osint tookie-osint advanced open-source tool for locating social media accounts based on username, name, or keyword inputs. offers fuzzy-matching capabilities beyond sherlock's exact-match approach, useful when a target uses slight variations of their handle across platforms. tookie-osint 是一款進階的社交媒體帳號搜尋工具,具備比 sherlock 更豐富的模糊搜尋能力,適合針對特定個人進行跨平台帳號關聯分析。 advanced osint information gathering tool for social media accounts. username social-media enumeration advanced open-source username candidate account pages or public account context, not verified identity. 候選帳號頁面或公開帳號背景,並非已核實身份。 username person social-media search for accounts using similar usernames with slight variations track a target's multi-platform social footprint in counter-fraud investigations perform cross-platform account correlation analysis for a specific individual 搜尋使用相似使用者名稱(微幅變形)的帳號 在反詐欺調查中追蹤目標的跨平台社群足跡 對特定個人進行跨平台帳號關聯分析

maigret.name: maigret
maigret.text: maigret maigret username osint tool that checks thousands of sites and aggregates additional personal identifiers (real name, location, linked accounts) from profile data where available. produces richer dossiers than simpler enumeration tools by chaining discovered data. maigret 可透過用戶名在數千個網站上收集個人資訊檔案,從帳號資料中聚合真實姓名、位置與關聯帳號,產生比 sherlock 更豐富的調查報告。 collect a dossier on a person by username only, using data from thousands of sites. username social-media enumeration profiling open-source username candidate account pages or public account context, not verified identity. 候選帳號頁面或公開帳號背景,並非已核實身份。 username person social-media build a detailed profile from a single username by chaining discovered identifiers automatically generate an html investigation report from username search results identify a subject's linked accounts when they use the same handle on niche platforms 透過串接已發現的識別碼,從單一使用者名稱建立詳細檔案 從使用者名稱搜尋結果自動生成 html 調查報告 當調查對象在小眾平台使用相同帳號名稱時,識別其關聯帳號

holehe.name: holehe
holehe.text: holehe holehe email-to-account enumeration tool that checks whether an email address is registered on 120+ platforms including twitter, instagram, and github. works by testing registration flows without creating accounts, making it an efficient passive email osint step. holehe 可檢查一個電子郵件地址是否在超過 120 個網站(包括 twitter、instagram、github 等)上注冊了帳號,透過測試注冊流程而無需建立帳號,是高效的被動電子郵件 osint 工具。 check if an email is attached to an account on over 120 websites. email username enumeration social-media open-source email exposure or candidate account signals; these do not identify the current owner. 外洩或候選帳號訊號;不能確認目前使用者。 email username person social-media check which platforms a target email address is registered on link a known email to social media accounts before conducting deeper research verify whether an email address belongs to an active online identity 檢查目標電子郵件地址在哪些平台上註冊了帳號 在進行更深度的調查前,將已知電子郵件連結至其社群媒體帳號 驗證電子郵件地址是否屬於活躍的網路身分

hunter.name: hunter.io
hunter.text: hunter.io hunter email discovery service that finds professionally used email addresses associated with a domain, discovers the email format pattern used by an organization, and verifies deliverability. useful for identifying employee contacts in corporate investigations. hunter.io 是一個電子郵件地址發現與驗證服務,可根據域名查找公開的員工電子郵件地址,識別組織使用的電子郵件格式,並驗證郵件地址的可達性。 email finder and verification service. email domain corporate verification website company email published contact or infrastructure leads; check provenance. 公開聯絡或基礎設施線索;核對出處。 email domain organization person find publicly listed email addresses associated with a company domain identify an organization's email naming pattern (e.g., first.last@company.com) verify whether a discovered email address is deliverable before use in an investigation 尋找與公司網域關聯的公開列出電子郵件地址 識別組織的電子郵件命名規則(例如 first.last@company.com) 在調查使用前,驗證所發現的電子郵件地址是否可送達

phonebook-cz.name: phonebook.cz
phonebook-cz.text: phonebook.cz phonebook-cz free email and domain intelligence lookup that returns all associated email addresses, subdomains, and urls for a given query. aggregates from passive sources and breach data, making it fast for enumerating corporate email exposure. phonebook.cz 是免費的電子郵件與網域情報查詢工具,可返回指定域名的所有關聯電子郵件地址、子網域與 url,來源包含被動公開資料與洩露資料集。 lists all domains, email addresses, or urls for a given input domain. email domain subdomain enumeration website company email published contact or infrastructure leads; check provenance. 公開聯絡或基礎設施線索;核對出處。 email domain organization enumerate all email addresses exposed under a corporate domain quickly surface subdomains for a target domain from aggregated passive data cross-reference email lists against breach databases for exposure assessment 列舉企業網域下暴露的所有電子郵件地址 從彙整的被動數據中快速呈現目標網域的子網域 將電子郵件清單與外洩資料庫進行交叉比對以進行暴露評估

securitytrails.name: securitytrails
securitytrails.text: securitytrails securitytrails domain and ip intelligence platform providing historical dns records, subdomain enumeration, whois history, and associated infrastructure data. essential for tracing domain ownership changes and discovering previously connected infrastructure. securitytrails 提供歷史 dns 記錄、子網域枚舉、whois 歷史及相關基礎設施資料,是追蹤網域所有權變更與發現過去連接基礎設施的重要工具。 historical dns data, subdomain finder, and domain intelligence api. dns domain subdomain whois historical website domain and dns context; historical associations need corroboration. 網域與 dns 背景;歷史關聯需佐證。 domain ip organization retrieve historical dns a records to find ip addresses a domain previously resolved to discover all subdomains for a target domain from passive dns data trace whois ownership history to identify prior registrants of a suspicious domain 檢索歷史 dns a 記錄以尋找網域先前解析過的 ip 地址 從被動 dns 數據中發現目標網域的所有子網域 追蹤 whois 所有權歷史以識別可疑網域的先前註冊人

dnsdumpster.name: dnsdumpster
dnsdumpster.text: dnsdumpster dnsdumpster free passive dns research tool that generates visual network maps of a domain's dns records, subdomains, mx servers, and host relationships. no account required; results are delivered as a diagram and downloadable spreadsheet. dnsdumpster 是一個免費的被動 dns 研究工具,可生成網域 dns 記錄、子網域、mx 伺服器和主機關係的視覺化網路地圖,無需帳號,結果以圖表和試算表呈現。 free domain research tool for dns recon and network mapping. dns domain subdomain network visualization website domain and dns context; historical associations need corroboration. 網域與 dns 背景;歷史關聯需佐證。 domain ip network generate a visual dns map of a target domain's subdomains and mail servers identify mx records to understand an organization's email infrastructure get a quick passive overview of a domain's network footprint before deeper analysis 生成目標網域的子網域與郵件伺服器的視覺化 dns 地圖 識別 mx 記錄以瞭解組織的電子郵件基礎設施 在深入分析前,快速獲取網域網路足跡的被動概覽

subfinder.name: subfinder
subfinder.text: subfinder subfinder fast passive subdomain discovery tool that aggregates results from certificate transparency logs, dns records, and 40+ passive data sources. produces clean, deduplicated subdomain lists without touching the target's servers. subfinder 是一款快速的被動子網域發現工具,從憑證透明度日誌、dns 記錄和 40 多個被動資料來源聚合結果,在不接觸目標伺服器的情況下產生乾淨的子網域列表。 passive subdomain discovery tool. subdomain domain passive-recon open-source website candidate subdomains; verify current dns and relevance. 候選子網域;核對目前 dns 與相關性。 domain network organization enumerate all passive-source subdomains for a target domain before authorized testing feed discovered subdomains into further enumeration or vulnerability scanning pipelines rapidly map an organization's subdomain landscape using certificate transparency data 在授權測試前,從被動來源列舉目標網域的所有子網域 將發現的子網域傳輸到進一步的列舉或漏洞掃描管道中 利用憑證透明度數據快速映射組織的子網域分佈圖

builtwith.name: builtwith
builtwith.text: builtwith builtwith website technology profiler that identifies the full stack of a web property — cms, javascript frameworks, analytics tools, cdn, email service providers, and more. useful for understanding a target's technology footprint and identifying potential attack vectors. builtwith 可識別網站使用的完整技術棧,包括 cms、javascript 框架、分析工具、cdn 和電子郵件服務提供商,有助於了解目標的技術足跡和識別潛在攻擊向量。 find out what a website is built with. technology-profiling domain web corporate website observed website technologies or indexed code matches. 網站技術觀察或已索引的程式碼匹配。 domain organization profile a target organization's web technology stack for security assessment identify which third-party analytics and marketing tools expose a site's data flows discover cms version information that may indicate unpatched vulnerabilities 剖析目標組織的網站技術棧以進行安全評估 識別哪些第三方分析與行銷工具暴露了網站的數據流 發現可能指出未修補漏洞的 cms 版本資訊

wayback-machine.name: wayback machine
wayback-machine.text: wayback machine wayback-machine internet archive's web snapshot service storing billions of archived web pages dating back to 1996. retrieve deleted pages, track how a website changed over time, and recover content that has been actively removed — all without touching the live target. wayback machine 是 internet archive 的網頁快照服務,儲存了數十億個自 1996 年以來的網頁歸檔,可用於檢索已刪除頁面、追蹤網站變更,以及在不接觸活躍目標的情況下恢復已刪除內容。 internet archive's wayback machine for historical website snapshots. archive historical web passive-recon website captured historical pages, with gaps in time and coverage. 歷史保存頁面,時間與涵蓋範圍可能有缺口。 domain organization document retrieve deleted pages or removed content from a target website track changes to a domain's homepage and content over months or years recover whois or contact information that was later scrubbed from a site 從目標網站檢索已刪除的頁面或移除的內容 追蹤網域首頁和內容在數月或數年期間的變更 恢復後來從網站上清除的 whois 或聯絡資訊

viewdns.name: viewdns.info
viewdns.text: viewdns.info viewdns multi-tool dns and domain investigation platform offering reverse ip lookups, whois queries, dns record history, ip geolocation, and port scanning. useful for correlating ips with hosted domains and tracing domain registration history. viewdns.info 是多功能 dns 和網域調查平台,提供反向 ip 查詢、whois 查詢、dns 記錄歷史、ip 地理定位和端口掃描,有助於關聯 ip 與託管網域以及追蹤網域注冊歷史。 free dns lookup, reverse ip, and domain research tools. dns domain whois reverse-ip ip website domain and dns context; historical associations need corroboration. 網域與 dns 背景;歷史關聯需佐證。 domain ip organization perform a reverse ip lookup to find all domains hosted on a shared server query historical whois records to identify previous domain registrants check which dns records changed around a suspicious domain transfer date 執行反向 ip 查詢以尋找託管在共享伺服器上的所有網域 查詢歷史 whois 記錄以識別先前的網域註冊人 檢查可疑網域移轉日期前後變更的 dns 記錄

ipinfo.name: ipinfo
ipinfo.text: ipinfo ipinfo ip address intelligence platform providing asn, geolocation, isp, carrier, hosting provider, and abuse contact data for any ip address. widely used as the first lookup step when investigating an ip address in an incident or intelligence report. ipinfo 提供任意 ip 地址的 asn、地理位置、isp、運營商、托管提供商和濫用聯繫資料,是調查事件或情報報告中 ip 地址時的標準首步查詢工具。 ip address geolocation and network intelligence api. ip geolocation network asn ip network ownership and approximate network context, not a person’s location. 網路歸屬與概略背景,並非個人的位置。 ip network geolocation identify the asn, hosting provider, and geolocation of a suspicious ip address determine whether an ip is a vpn, datacenter, or residential address retrieve abuse contact information for reporting malicious ip activity 識別可疑 ip 地址的 asn、託管提供商與地理位置 判斷 ip 是 vpn、資料中心還是住宅網路地址 檢索濫用聯絡資訊以舉報惡意 ip 活動

greynoise.name: greynoise
greynoise.text: greynoise greynoise threat intelligence platform that classifies internet-wide scanning and noise-generating ip addresses. identifies whether an ip is a known scanner, benign research tool, or malicious actor — helping analysts separate signal from noise in security investigations. greynoise 是威脅情報平台,對全網掃描和生成噪音的 ip 地址進行分類,幫助分析師區分掃描器、良性研究工具和惡意行為者,以便在安全調查中區分信號與噪音。 context on internet scanner ip addresses and noise in your security data. ip threat-intelligence reputation scanner-detection ip observed or reported network activity; assess timing and context. 觀察或回報的網路活動;需評估時間與背景。 ip network determine whether a suspicious ip is a known mass scanner before escalating an alert filter benign internet-wide scanner traffic from actual targeted intrusion attempts enrich ip intelligence reports with community-sourced scanner classification 在呈報警報前,判斷可疑 ip 是否為已知的群發掃描器 從實際針對性的入侵企圖中過濾出無害的網際網路掃描流量 透過社群來源的掃描器分類豐富 ip 情報報告

abuseipdb.name: abuseipdb
abuseipdb.text: abuseipdb abuseipdb community-driven ip abuse reporting and lookup service. returns a confidence score and report history for an ip address based on community submissions. useful for quickly assessing whether an ip has been flagged for spam, brute force, or scanning activity. abuseipdb 是社群驅動的 ip 濫用舉報和查詢服務,根據社群提交返回 ip 地址的置信度分數和舉報歷史,可快速評估 ip 是否因垃圾郵件、暴力破解或掃描活動而被標記。 database of abusive ip addresses reported by the community. ip reputation abuse community ip observed or reported network activity; assess timing and context. 觀察或回報的網路活動;需評估時間與背景。 ip network check an ip address's community-reported abuse history before investigating further verify whether a source ip in server logs is a known bad actor report abusive ip addresses to help the community flag malicious infrastructure 在進一步調查前,檢查 ip 地址由社群通報的濫用歷史記錄 驗證伺服器日誌中的來源 ip 是否為已知的惡意行為者 舉報有濫用行為的 ip 地址,以協助社群標記惡意基礎設施

bgp-he-net.name: bgp.he.net
bgp-he-net.text: bgp.he.net bgp-he-net free bgp and network routing intelligence tool by hurricane electric. look up asn details, ip prefixes, peering relationships, and routing paths. useful for mapping an organization's full ip address range and understanding their internet connectivity. bgp.he.net 是 hurricane electric 提供的免費 bgp 和網路路由情報工具,可查詢 asn 詳情、ip 前綴、對等關係和路由路徑,有助於繪製組織的完整 ip 地址範圍。 bgp routing information, asn lookups, and network peering data by hurricane electric. asn ip network routing bgp ip network ownership and approximate network context, not a person’s location. 網路歸屬與概略背景,並非個人的位置。 ip network organization look up all ip prefixes and asns registered to a target organization map peering relationships to understand an organization's internet routing topology find cidr blocks associated with a suspicious asn for further ip investigation 查詢註冊給目標組織的所有 ip 前綴和 asn 映射對等連結關係以瞭解組織的網際網路路由拓撲 尋找與可疑 asn 關聯的 cidr 區塊以進行進一步的 ip 調查

tineye.name: tineye
tineye.text: tineye tineye reverse image search engine that finds where an image appears online, tracks image usage history, and identifies the oldest known version of a photo. useful for verifying image provenance and detecting stock photo or stolen image misuse. tineye 是反向圖片搜尋引擎,可找到圖片在網路上出現的位置,追蹤圖片使用歷史,並識別照片最早的已知版本,有助於驗證圖片出處和檢測圖片盜用。 reverse image search engine. image reverse-image verification passive-recon image candidate matching images and source pages; compare dates and context. 候選相似圖片與來源頁;比較日期與上下文。 image person verify when and where an image first appeared online to detect fabricated context identify stock photo usage in fake profile pictures or disinformation campaigns track unauthorized redistribution of copyrighted images across the web 驗證圖片首次出現在網路上的時間和地點,以偵測捏造的背景資訊 在虛假頭像或虛假訊息宣傳活動中識別圖庫相片的使用 追蹤受版權保護圖片在網路上的未授權再散布情況

yandex-images.name: yandex images
yandex-images.text: yandex images yandex-images candidate matching images and source pages; compare dates and context. 候選相似圖片與來源頁;比較日期與上下文。 reverse image search by yandex, particularly strong for eastern european and russian content. image reverse-image face-recognition passive-recon image candidate matching images and source pages; compare dates and context. 候選相似圖片與來源頁;比較日期與上下文。 image person perform reverse image search for persons when google returns insufficient results identify eastern european or russian social media profiles from a photograph cross-validate face-based search results against multiple reverse image engines 當 google 傳回的結果不足時,對人像進行反向圖片搜尋 從相片中識別東歐或俄羅斯的社群媒體個人檔案 對比多個反向影像引擎來交叉驗證人臉搜尋結果

opencorporates.name: opencorporates
opencorporates.text: opencorporates opencorporates world's largest open database of company registration data, covering 200+ jurisdictions. search by company name or registration number to retrieve official filing details, registered addresses, directors, and corporate relationships — all from public registry sources. opencorporates 是全球最大的公司注冊資料開放資料庫,覆蓋 200 多個司法管轄區,可透過公司名稱或注冊號碼查詢官方備案詳情、注冊地址、董事和企業關係。 the largest open database of companies in the world. company corporate registry ownership company person company records and, where available, named officers. 公司記錄,以及部分來源提供的負責人資料。 organization person verify a company's legal status, registered address, and active filings across jurisdictions trace corporate ownership chains to identify beneficial owners or shell companies investigate a director's other company affiliations and related corporate structures 驗證公司在各司法管轄區的法定地位、註冊地址和活躍申報記錄 追蹤企業所有權鏈以識別實質受益人或空殼公司 調查董事的其他公司任職與關聯企業結構

crunchbase.name: crunchbase
crunchbase.text: crunchbase crunchbase business intelligence platform covering startup and corporate funding rounds, acquisitions, key personnel, investors, and company timelines. useful for building a financial and organizational profile of a target company and tracing investor relationships. crunchbase 是覆蓋初創公司和企業融資輪次、收購、關鍵人員、投資者和公司發展歷程的商業情報平台,有助於建立目標公司的財務和組織概況。 business intelligence on companies, investors, and funding. company corporate funding people startup company person reported company and professional background; corroborate primary records. 彙整的公司與職業背景;需與原始記錄核對。 organization person research a company's funding history, investors, and key personnel for due diligence identify executive team members and their professional backgrounds trace acquisition and investment relationships between corporate entities 研究公司的融資歷史、投資者和關鍵人員以進行盡職調查 識別高階主管團隊成員及其專業背景 追蹤企業實體之間的收購與投資關係

companies-house.name: companies house
companies-house.text: companies house companies-house official uk government company registry providing free access to all registered company filings including accounts, director appointments, and shareholder information. authoritative source for investigating uk-registered entities. 英國官方公司注冊局,提供免費訪問所有注冊公司備案,包括賬目、董事任命和股東信息,是調查英國注冊實體的權威來源。 uk company registration and filing data from companies house. company corporate registry uk directors company person company records and, where available, named officers. 公司記錄,以及部分來源提供的負責人資料。 organization person verify the legal status and filing history of a uk-registered company identify current and resigned directors of a uk company under investigation download official company accounts to assess financial health and undisclosed liabilities 驗證在英國註冊的公司的法定地位和申報歷史 識別接受調查的英國公司現任及已離任董事 下載官方公司帳目以評估財務狀況和未揭露的負債

linkedin.name: linkedin
linkedin.text: linkedin linkedin professional social network and essential source for corporate osint. employee profiles reveal job titles, tenure, skills, connections, and company affiliations. useful for identifying organizational structure, key personnel, and technology stack clues from job listings. linkedin 是專業社交網絡,也是企業 osint 的重要來源。員工資料揭示職位、任期、技能和公司關係,有助於識別組織結構、關鍵人員。 professional social network for career and corporate intelligence. social-media corporate people passive-recon person company username candidate public profiles and professional context. 候選公開檔案與職業背景。 person organization social-media map an organization's employee structure, reporting lines, and key technical staff infer technology stack and security posture from job postings and engineer profiles identify recent departures and new hires that may indicate organizational changes 映射組織的員工結構、匯報關係與關鍵技術人員 從職缺公告和工程師檔案推導技術棧與安全狀態 識別近期離職和新聘人員,這可能指出組織結構變動

dehashed.name: dehashed
dehashed.text: dehashed dehashed breach data search engine that indexes leaked databases and allows queries by email, username, ip, name, phone, or password hash. returns the specific breach source and exposed fields for each match. paid subscription required for full results. dehashed 是一個索引洩露資料庫的突破資料搜尋引擎,允許通過電子郵件、用戶名、ip、姓名、電話或密碼哈希查詢,返回每個匹配的特定洩露來源和暴露字段。 hacked database search engine for breach data. breach credentials email username search-engine email exposure or candidate account signals; these do not identify the current owner. 外洩或候選帳號訊號;不能確認目前使用者。 email username person ip search by email or username to identify all known breach sources exposing an account retrieve password hashes associated with a target for forensic analysis cross-reference multiple data points (name + phone) to confirm identity in breach records 透過電子郵件或使用者名稱搜尋,以識別暴露帳號的所有已知外洩來源 檢索與目標關聯的密碼雜湊值(hash)以進行鑑識分析 在資料外洩記錄中交叉比對多個數據點(姓名 + 電話)以確認身份

leakcheck.name: leakcheck.io
leakcheck.text: leakcheck.io leakcheck breach lookup service that queries a regularly updated database of leaked credentials by email, username, phone, or domain. returns breach sources with details on what data was exposed. offers api access for bulk checks. leakcheck.io 是一個定期更新的洩露憑證查詢服務,可通過電子郵件、用戶名、電話或域名查詢,返回洩露來源及暴露的數據詳情,並提供批量查詢的 api 訪問。 email and username breach lookup service. breach email username credentials api email exposure or candidate account signals; these do not identify the current owner. 外洩或候選帳號訊號;不能確認目前使用者。 email username phone person check an email address against a continuously updated breach database bulk-check an organization's email domain for credential exposure using the api verify whether a phone number appears in known breach datasets 對比持續更新的資料外洩資料庫檢查電子郵件地址 使用 api 批次檢查組織的電子郵件網域是否存在憑證外洩 驗證電話號碼是否出現在已知的外洩數據集中

breachdirectory.name: breach directory
breachdirectory.text: breach directory breachdirectory free breach lookup tool that checks email addresses against a large dataset of known data breaches. returns the breach name and a partial preview of exposed data. a useful free starting point before using paid services like dehashed. breach directory 是免費的洩露資料庫查詢工具,可對已知資料洩露的大型數據集檢查電子郵件地址,返回洩露名稱和暴露數據的部分預覽,是使用 dehashed 等付費服務前有用的免費起點。 free breach database lookup tool. breach email free credentials email exposure or candidate account signals; these do not identify the current owner. 外洩或候選帳號訊號;不能確認目前使用者。 email username person quickly check an email address for breach exposure without a paid subscription identify which breach events affected a target email as a starting point combine with hibp results for a more complete breach coverage picture 在沒有付費訂閱的情況下,快速檢查電子郵件地址是否暴露於外洩事件中 識別哪些外洩事件影響了目標電子郵件,以此作為調查起點 結合 hibp 結果以獲得更完整的資料外洩覆蓋全貌

virustotal.name: virustotal
virustotal.text: virustotal virustotal multi-engine file and url analysis platform that aggregates results from 70+ antivirus engines, sandbox analysis, and community threat intelligence. also provides domain and ip enrichment with dns history, whois data, and passive dns. an essential first lookup in any threat investigation. virustotal 是多引擎文件和 url 分析平台,聚合 70 多個防病毒引擎、沙盒分析和社群威脅情報的結果,同時提供帶有 dns 歷史、whois 數據和被動 dns 的域名和 ip 豐富化功能。 analyze files and urls for malware using 70+ antivirus engines. threat-intelligence malware url-scan domain ip file-analysis website ip document reputation records or analysis reports; submitting a url may trigger visits. 信譽記錄或分析報告;提交網址可能觸發網站訪問。 domain ip document network analyze a suspicious url or file hash against 70+ engines to check for malware enrich a domain or ip with passive dns history and community threat tags identify which threat actor campaigns have used a specific file hash or infrastructure 對比 70 多個引擎分析可疑 url 或檔案雜湊值以檢查惡意軟體 利用被動 dns 歷史和社群威脅標籤豐富網域或 ip 資訊 識別威脅主體活動曾使用過哪些特定檔案雜湊值或基礎設施

urlscan.name: urlscan.io
urlscan.text: urlscan.io urlscan website sandbox scanner that loads a url in an isolated browser, captures a full screenshot, and records all network requests, redirects, loaded scripts, and dns lookups. useful for safely analyzing suspicious urls without exposing your own browser to potential threats. urlscan.io 是網站沙盒掃描器,在隔離瀏覽器中加載 url,捕獲完整截圖,並記錄所有網絡請求、重定向、加載的腳本和 dns 查詢,有助於安全地分析可疑 url。 website scanner that takes a screenshot and analyzes loaded resources. url-scan threat-intelligence phishing web domain website ip document reputation records or analysis reports; submitting a url may trigger visits. 信譽記錄或分析報告;提交網址可能觸發網站訪問。 domain ip network safely analyze a suspicious or phishing url without opening it in your own browser capture a screenshot and resource list for a potentially malicious website as evidence review historical scans of a domain to track changes in its hosted content over time 安全地分析可疑或網路釣魚 url,而無需在您自己的瀏覽器中開啟它 擷取潛在惡意網站的螢幕截圖和資源清單作為證據 審查網域的歷史掃描記錄,以追蹤其託管內容隨時間的變更

alienvault-otx.name: alienvault otx
alienvault-otx.text: alienvault otx alienvault-otx open threat intelligence community where security researchers share indicators of compromise (iocs) including malicious ips, domains, file hashes, and attack patterns. search for a domain or ip to retrieve community-sourced threat tags and associated attack pulses. alienvault otx 是開放的威脅情報社群,安全研究人員在此分享妥協指標(iocs),包括惡意 ip、域名、文件哈希和攻擊模式。可搜尋域名或 ip 以獲取社群標籤的威脅標籤。 open threat intelligence community and threat data platform. threat-intelligence ioc malware domain ip community ip website shared indicator and threat-context records; compare sources and dates. 共享的指標與威脅背景記錄;比較來源與日期。 domain ip network search a suspicious domain or ip for community-reported threat intelligence look up a file hash to check if it's associated with known malware campaigns retrieve related attack pulses and iocs to understand a threat actor's infrastructure 搜尋可疑網域或 ip 的社群回報威脅情報 查詢檔案雜湊值以檢查其是否與已知的惡意軟體活動關聯 檢索相關的攻擊脈絡與 ioc 以瞭解威脅主體的基礎設施

socialblade.name: social blade
socialblade.text: social blade socialblade social media analytics platform tracking subscriber/follower counts, growth trends, estimated earnings, and historical statistics for youtube, twitch, twitter/x, instagram, and tiktok accounts. useful for detecting artificial growth patterns indicative of botting or coordinated manipulation. social blade 是追蹤 youtube、twitch、twitter/x、instagram 和 tiktok 帳號的訂閱者/粉絲數量、增長趨勢、估計收益和歷史統計數據的社交媒體分析平台,有助於檢測機器人操縱模式。 social media statistics and analytics tracker. social-media analytics youtube twitter growth-tracking username candidate account pages or public account context, not verified identity. 候選帳號頁面或公開帳號背景,並非已核實身份。 person social-media organization detect abnormal follower growth spikes that indicate purchased followers or botting track historical subscriber counts to estimate when content went viral or was suppressed compare growth trajectories across multiple social accounts for coordinated behavior analysis 偵測指出購買粉絲或機器人活動的異常粉絲成長高峰 追蹤歷史訂閱者數量,以評估內容何時瘋傳或被壓制 比較多個社群帳號的成長軌跡以進行協同行為分析

nitter.name: nitter
nitter.text: nitter nitter privacy-focused alternative twitter/x front-end that lets you browse tweets, profiles, and search results without a login or javascript. useful for passive observation of public twitter accounts without alerting the target through algorithmic recommendation exposure. nitter 是注重隱私的替代 twitter/x 前端,無需登錄或 javascript 即可瀏覽推文、個人資料和搜尋結果,有助於被動觀察公開 twitter 帳號而不讓算法推薦暴露調查行為。 alternative twitter/x front-end without javascript tracking. social-media twitter passive-recon privacy username candidate account pages or public account context, not verified identity. 候選帳號頁面或公開帳號背景,並非已核實身份。 person social-media browse a target's twitter timeline and media without logging in or triggering recommendations search twitter content and hashtags passively without creating an investigator account archive target tweets for evidence without interacting with the account 在不登入或不觸發推薦演算法的情況下,瀏覽目標的 twitter 時間軸和媒體 被動搜尋 twitter 內容和標籤,而無需建立調查人員帳號 封存目標推文作為證據,而不與該帳號發生任何互動

social-analyzer.name: social analyzer
social-analyzer.text: social analyzer social-analyzer open-source tool that searches for a person's profiles across 1000+ social media and web platforms. provides confidence scores for matches and can extract profile metadata. more comprehensive platform coverage than sherlock with a web ui option. social analyzer 是開源工具,可在 1000 多個社交媒體和網絡平台上搜尋一個人的個人資料,為匹配提供置信度分數,並可提取個人資料元數據。 analyze and find a person's profile across 1000+ social media sites. username social-media enumeration open-source profiling username candidate account pages or public account context, not verified identity. 候選帳號頁面或公開帳號背景,並非已核實身份。 username person social-media search for a person's profiles across 1000+ platforms with confidence scoring extract publicly available profile metadata from discovered accounts generate an investigation report from multi-platform username results 在 1000 多個平台上搜尋個人的檔案,並提供可信度評分 從發現的帳號中提取公開可用的個人檔案後設資料(metadata) 從跨平台使用者名稱結果生成調查報告

google-earth.name: google earth
google-earth.text: google earth google-earth satellite and aerial imagery platform with historical imagery layers and street view. essential for geolocation investigations — identify building architecture, vegetation patterns, terrain features, and infrastructure to confirm or rule out claimed locations. google earth 是帶有歷史影像層和街景的衛星和航空影像平台,是地理定位調查的核心工具,可識別建築架構、植被模式、地形特徵和基礎設施以確認或排除聲稱位置。 satellite imagery and street-level geolocation tool. geolocation image satellite mapping verification location map, imagery or location clues; check capture date and multiple landmarks. 地圖、影像或地點線索;核對拍攝日期與多個地標。 geolocation image geolocate a photograph by matching visible landmarks, terrain, and vegetation to satellite imagery compare historical satellite imagery to verify when structures were built or demolished corroborate claimed locations in user-generated content using street view and aerial views 透過比對可見地標、地形和植被與衛星影像,對相片進行地理定位 比對歷史衛星影像以驗證建築物何時建造或拆除 使用街景服務與鳥瞰視角佐證使用者生成內容中所聲稱的位置

foca.name: foca
foca.text: foca foca metadata extraction and analysis tool for documents discovered via search engines. fingerprints an organization by extracting author names, software versions, internal network paths, and printer names from publicly downloadable office, pdf, and other document files. foca 是通過搜尋引擎發現的文件的元數據提取和分析工具,透過從公開可下載的 office、pdf 等文件中提取作者名稱、軟件版本、內部網絡路徑和打印機名稱來對組織進行指紋識別。 fingerprinting organizations with collected archives. metadata document corporate fingerprinting open-source image document video file metadata that may be missing or altered. 可能缺失或被修改的檔案中繼資料。 document organization extract author usernames, software versions, and internal paths from public documents identify internal infrastructure details from metadata in published pdf and office files map an organization's technology stack from leaked document metadata 從公開文件中提取作者使用者名稱、軟體版本和內部路徑 從發布的 pdf 和 office 檔案的後設資料中識別內部基礎設施細節 從外洩的文件後設資料映射組織的技術棧

sec-edgar.name: sec edgar
sec-edgar.text: sec edgar sec-edgar official us sec database containing all public company filings: annual reports (10-k), quarterly reports (10-q), proxy statements, insider trading disclosures (forms 3/4/5), and ipo prospectuses. free, full-text searchable. authoritative source for us publicly traded companies. 美國證券交易委員會(sec)的公開申報資料庫,涵蓋上市公司年報(10-k)、季報(10-q)、委託書聲明、內部人交易揭露及 ipo 招股書,是美國上市公司的權威資料來源。 us securities and exchange commission public filing database. government-records sec-filings public-records corporate financial company person document public filings; names need context and matching identifiers. 公開申報文件;姓名需搭配其他識別資料。 organization person look up a us company's financial filings, executive compensation, and beneficial ownership identify insider stock transactions and large shareholder positions (form 13f/13g/13d) research the background of a public company's officers and board members 查詢美國公司的財務申報、高階主管薪酬和實質受益所有權 識別內部人股權交易與大股東持股部位(form 13f/13g/13d) 研究上市公司主管和董事會成員的背景

pacer.name: pacer
pacer.text: pacer pacer us federal court electronic records system providing access to case filings, dockets, and documents from all 94 us district courts, 13 circuit courts of appeals, and the us bankruptcy courts. low per-page access fee. invaluable for litigation research and background investigations. 美國聯邦法院電子案卷系統(pacer),提供全美 94 個地區法院、13 個上訴巡迴法院及破產法院的案件卷宗和文件,是訴訟研究和背景調查的必備資源。 public access to court electronic records — us federal court documents. government-records court-records public-records litigation person company candidate court records; coverage and access vary. 候選法院記錄;涵蓋範圍與存取条件不同。 person organization search for civil or criminal lawsuits involving a company or individual access bankruptcy filings to understand a company's financial distress history retrieve court-ordered discovery documents and settlement records 搜尋涉及公司或個人的民事或刑事訴訟 存取破產申報以瞭解公司的財務困境歷史 檢索法院命令的開示程序文件和和解記錄

icij-offshore-leaks.name: icij offshore leaks database
icij-offshore-leaks.text: icij offshore leaks database icij-offshore-leaks international consortium of investigative journalists' searchable database of over 800,000 offshore entities from major leaks including panama papers, paradise papers, pandora papers, and bahamas leaks. links companies, officers, and intermediaries with registered addresses and beneficial owners. 國際調查記者同盟(icij)的離岸公司資料庫,收錄巴拿馬文件、天堂文件、潘朵拉文件等重大洩露事件中逾 80 萬個離岸實體,並關聯公司、高管與中間人資訊。 icij database of offshore companies from panama papers, paradise papers, pandora papers, and other leaks. government-records public-records financial offshore leaks person company candidate entries with source references; a match is not an identity conclusion. 含出處的候選條目;匹配不等於身份確認。 organization person search whether a company or individual appears in any major offshore document leak trace beneficial ownership of shell companies through the interconnected entity graph cross-reference offshore entities with known sanctions targets or peps 搜尋公司或個人是否出現在任何重大的離岸文件洩漏事件中 透過相互連結的實體圖追蹤空殼公司的實質受益所有權 將離岸實體與已知的制裁目標或 pep 進行交叉比對

opensanctions.name: opensanctions
opensanctions.text: opensanctions opensanctions open-source database aggregating global sanctions lists, politically exposed persons (peps), and criminal watchlists from over 100 sources including ofac, un security council, eu, and interpol. freely searchable with api access. used in kyc, compliance, and investigative journalism. 彙整全球制裁名單、政治曝光人士(pep)及犯罪監控名單的開源資料庫,來源超過 100 個,包含 ofac、聯合國安理會、歐盟及國際刑警組織,支援 api 存取。 open database of sanctioned entities, politically exposed persons, and persons of interest. government-records sanctions public-records compliance pep person company candidate entries with source references; a match is not an identity conclusion. 含出處的候選條目;匹配不等於身份確認。 person organization check whether an individual or entity appears on any global sanctions list screen for politically exposed persons (peps) during kyc or due diligence build a compliance watchlist pipeline using the free api 檢查個人或實體是否出現在任何全球制裁清單中 在 kyc 或盡職調查期間篩選政治顯要人物(peps) 使用免費 api 建立合規觀察清單管道

muckrock.name: muckrock
muckrock.text: muckrock muckrock collaborative platform for filing, tracking, and sharing freedom of information act (foia) requests with us federal, state, and local agencies. hosts a public archive of thousands of released government documents. simplifies the foia process and crowdsources government transparency. muckrock 是美國資訊自由法(foia)申請的協作平台,支援向聯邦、州及地方政府機關提交、追蹤及分享申請,並公開已取得的政府文件檔案庫。 platform for filing and sharing foia requests in the us. government-records foia public-records transparency company person document released public-record documents and request context; access and fulfilment vary. 已公開的公共記錄文件與申請背景;存取及申請結果不同。 organization document file a foia request to a us government agency and track its progress search the archive of already-released foia documents from other requesters access police reports, surveillance records, and other government materials 向美國政府機構提出資訊自由法(foia)申請並追蹤其進度 搜尋來自其他申請人已釋出 foia 文件的封存檔案 獲取警政報告、監視記錄和其他政府資料

govinfo.name: govinfo
govinfo.text: govinfo govinfo us government publishing office (gpo) official repository providing free access to congressional records, federal register notices, code of federal regulations, gao reports, budget documents, and thousands of other official federal publications. authoritative, full-text searchable, with bulk download api. 美國政府出版局(gpo)的官方數位典藏庫,免費提供國會記錄、聯邦公報通知、聯邦法規彙編、gao 報告及預算文件等大量聯邦政府出版品。 official digital repository of us federal government publications. government-records public-records regulatory federal company person document published documents; examine the original and its jurisdiction. 公開文件;需閱讀原件並核對管轄範圍。 organization document search federal register for agency rulemaking notices mentioning a specific company access historical congressional hearing transcripts and committee reports download gao audit reports and inspector general findings 搜尋聯邦公報中提及特定公司的機構制定規則通知 存取歷史國會聽證會逐字稿和委員會報告 下載政府問責署(gao)審計報告和監察長調查結果

judyrecords.name: judyrecords
judyrecords.text: judyrecords judyrecords free aggregated search engine covering over 600 million us court case records from state and federal courts. search by party name, attorney, case number, or court. broader state-level coverage than pacer. useful for quickly surfacing litigation history before deep-diving into primary court dockets. 免費的美國法院案件搜尋引擎,收錄超過 6 億筆州及聯邦法院案件記錄,可依當事人姓名、律師、案號或法院搜尋,涵蓋範圍廣於 pacer。 search engine for us court cases across all 50 states. government-records court-records public-records litigation person company candidate court records; coverage and access vary. 候選法院記錄;涵蓋範圍與存取条件不同。 person organization quickly check if a person or company has litigation history across us states find case numbers before accessing full records in primary court systems screen a potential business partner for undisclosed legal disputes 快速檢查個人或公司在美國各州是否有訴訟歷史記錄 在存取主要法院系統的完整記錄前先尋找案號 篩選潛在商業合作夥伴是否有未揭露的法律糾紛

world-bank-contracts.name: world bank contracts
world-bank-contracts.text: world bank contracts world-bank-contracts world bank group public database of procurement contracts, awarded vendors, project financing, and debarment lists. useful for tracking companies receiving international development funding, identifying conflict-of-interest patterns, and researching entities banned from world bank projects. 世界銀行集團的採購合約、得標廠商、項目融資及禁止名單公開資料庫,適合追蹤獲得國際發展資金的企業、識別利益衝突模式及調查被世銀禁止的實體。 world bank procurement and contracts database. government-records public-records financial international procurement company person document published documents; examine the original and its jurisdiction. 公開文件;需閱讀原件並核對管轄範圍。 organization check if a company is on the world bank debarment list research which contractors receive world bank-funded infrastructure contracts identify cross-border funding patterns for corruption investigations 檢查公司是否在世界銀行排除名單(debarment list)中 研究哪些承包商獲得世界銀行資助的基礎建設合約 為貪腐調查識別跨國資金模式

invid-weverify.name: invid / weverify
invid-weverify.text: invid / weverify invid-weverify eu-funded browser extension for journalists and fact-checkers. extracts video keyframes for reverse image search, detects metadata, checks twitter api context, and scores image authenticity using ai. supported by afp, bbc, google news lab. indispensable for visual content verification. 歐盟資助的瀏覽器擴充套件,專為記者和事實核查人員設計,可提取影片關鍵幀、反向搜尋圖像、偵測元數據、查詢 twitter api 上下文,並以 ai 評分圖像真實性。 browser extension for verifying online videos and images. ai-osint image-verification video-verification fact-checking synthetic-media video image news video analysis clues to compare with source pages and independent evidence. 影片分析線索;需與來源頁及獨立證據核對。 image person verify whether a viral video was filmed at the claimed time and location extract keyframes from a video and run reverse image search on each frame check image metadata and detect signs of manipulation or tampering 驗證瘋傳影片是否在聲稱的時間和地點拍攝 從影片中提取關鍵畫格,並對每個畫格執行反向影像搜尋 檢查圖片後設資料並偵測是否有修改或竄改的跡象

hunchly.name: hunchly
hunchly.text: hunchly hunchly browser extension that automatically captures and archives every web page you visit during an investigation, with automatic hashing for evidentiary integrity. generates case reports, highlights keywords, and provides a timeline of captured evidence. paid but considered gold standard for professional investigators. hunchly 是瀏覽器擴充套件,在調查過程中自動捕獲並存檔每個訪問的網頁,並進行雜湊驗證以確保證據完整性,生成案件報告和關鍵字高亮時間軸。 web capture tool for osint investigations. ai-osint evidence-collection investigation archiving website captured research pages for later review. 保存的研究頁面,供之後核對。 person organization domain automatically capture and preserve web evidence during a live investigation build an auditable evidence trail with timestamped, hashed page captures generate a case report from captured web pages with keyword highlights 在即時調查期間自動擷取並保存網頁證據 使用帶有時間戳記、已雜湊的網頁擷取建立可審計的證據軌跡 從擷取的網頁中生成帶有關鍵字標示的案件報告

fotoforensics.name: fotoforensics
fotoforensics.text: fotoforensics fotoforensics free online image forensics tool that analyzes photos for manipulation using error level analysis (ela), metadata inspection, and lighting analysis. ela reveals regions where jpeg compression differs — a strong indicator of pixel-level editing or compositing. useful for detecting digitally altered images. 免費的線上圖像鑑識工具,使用誤差等級分析(ela)、元數據檢查和光照分析來偵測照片是否遭到竄改,ela 可揭示 jpeg 壓縮差異,是識別像素級編輯的有效指標。 image analysis and forgery detection tool. ai-osint image-forensics deepfake-detection image-verification metadata image image analysis signals; these do not independently establish authenticity. 影像分析訊號;不能單獨判定真偽。 image run error level analysis on a suspicious image to detect areas that were edited or composited extract exif metadata to check device, timestamp, and gps coordinates verify whether a document scan or photograph has been digitally altered 對可疑圖片執行誤差水平分析(error level analysis)以偵測被編輯或合成的區域 提取 exif 後設資料以檢查裝置、時間戳記和 gps 座標 驗證文件掃描檔或相片是否經過數位修改

ai-image-detector.name: ai image detector (hive)
