browserleaks.text: browserleaks browserleaks free suite of browser privacy tests that check for webrtc ip leaks, canvas fingerprinting, font fingerprinting, geolocation exposure, dns leaks, and other identifiable signals. use before conducting sensitive investigations to verify that your vpn, tor, or privacy tools are working correctly and not leaking your real identity. 免費的瀏覽器隱私測試套件,檢查 webrtc ip 洩漏、canvas 指紋、字體指紋、地理位置暴露、dns 洩漏等可識別信號,在敏感調查前使用以確認 vpn 或 tor 工具未洩露真實身份。 browser fingerprinting and privacy leak testing tool. opsec privacy fingerprinting operational-security preparation research environment or communication support; not a subject lookup. 研究環境或通訊輔助,並非對象查詢。 person check for webrtc ip leaks before starting a sensitive investigation session verify that tor browser or vpn is not exposing your real ip or dns queries test browser fingerprint uniqueness to assess tracking and deanonymization risk 在開始敏感的調查工作階段前,檢查是否有 webrtc ip 洩漏 驗證 tor 瀏覽器或 vpn 是否暴露了您的真實 ip 或 dns 查詢 測試瀏覽器指紋唯一性以評估追蹤與去匿名化風險

phoneinfoga.name: phoneinfoga
phoneinfoga.text: phoneinfoga phoneinfoga open-source osint framework for gathering publicly available information on phone numbers. validates number format, determines carrier and region, queries multiple public sources (numverify, google dork, ovh), and identifies associated online accounts. cli and web interface. passive-only; does not contact the number. 開源電話號碼情報收集框架,驗證號碼格式、確定運營商和地區、查詢多個公開來源(numverify、google dork、ovh),並識別關聯的線上帳號。僅被動查詢,不直接聯繫號碼。 advanced information gathering and osint framework for phone numbers. phone recon open-source phone number format or reported context; coverage varies and labels may be wrong. 號碼格式或回報背景;涵蓋範圍不同,標籤可能有誤。 phone person identify the carrier and geographic region of an unknown phone number check whether a phone number is associated with online accounts or leaked datasets validate a phone number format and determine country code before investigation 識別未知電話號碼的電信業者和地理區域 檢查電話號碼是否與線上帳號或外洩數據集關聯 在調查前驗證電話號碼格式並確定國碼

truecaller.name: truecaller
truecaller.text: truecaller truecaller crowdsourced caller id and phone spam detection service with a database of over 3 billion phone numbers. users can look up phone numbers to see user-submitted names and spam scores. note: truecaller's database is populated from user contact lists without explicit consent — consider privacy implications before relying on returned data. 眾包來電顯示和電話垃圾偵測服務,擁有超過 30 億個電話號碼資料庫,可查詢電話號碼以查看用戶提交的姓名和垃圾評分。注意:其資料庫從用戶聯絡人名單中未經明確同意收集,使用時需考慮隱私影響。 global phone number identification and caller id service. phone caller-id crowd-sourced phone number format or reported context; coverage varies and labels may be wrong. 號碼格式或回報背景;涵蓋範圍不同,標籤可能有誤。 phone person look up an unknown caller number to identify the associated name or organization check whether a phone number has been flagged as spam or fraudulent by the community verify contact information consistency when a name and phone number have been provided 查詢未知來電號碼以識別關聯的姓名或組織 檢查電話號碼是否已被社群標記為垃圾郵件或詐騙電話 當提供姓名和電話號碼時,驗證聯絡資訊的一致性

numverify.name: numverify
numverify.text: numverify numverify phone number validation api that verifies number format, confirms line type (mobile/landline/voip), returns carrier name, country code, and geographic region. used in compliance workflows, fraud detection, and osint preprocessing to validate number authenticity before deeper investigation. 電話號碼驗證 api,確認號碼格式、線路類型(手機/固話/voip)、返回運營商名稱、國家代碼和地理區域,用於合規工作流程、詐欺偵測和 osint 預處理中的號碼真實性驗證。 phone number validation and carrier lookup api. phone carrier-lookup validation phone number format or reported context; coverage varies and labels may be wrong. 號碼格式或回報背景;涵蓋範圍不同,標籤可能有誤。 phone validate whether a phone number is active and determine its carrier classify whether a number is mobile, landline, or voip enrich investigation leads by appending carrier and geographic data to phone numbers 驗證電話號碼是否為有效號碼並確定其電信業者 分類號碼是行動電話、市話還是 voip 電話 透過向電話號碼附加電信業者與地理數據來富集調查線索

opencnam.name: opencnam
opencnam.text: opencnam opencnam us caller id name (cnam) lookup api that queries the authoritative us cnam databases to return the registered name associated with a us telephone number. useful for verifying caller identity in the us context. paid per-query but integrates well into investigation pipelines. 美國來電顯示姓名(cnam)查詢 api,查詢美國 cnam 權威資料庫以返回與美國電話號碼關聯的已登記姓名,適用於美國情境下的來電身份驗證。 us caller id (cnam) lookup api. phone caller-id cnam phone number format or reported context; coverage varies and labels may be wrong. 號碼格式或回報背景;涵蓋範圍不同,標籤可能有誤。 phone look up the registered cnam name for a us phone number verify whether a us caller's name matches their claimed identity enrich us phone number leads with official cnam registration data 查詢美國電話號碼的註冊 cnam 姓名 驗證美國來電者的姓名是否與其聲稱的身份相符 以官方 cnam 註冊數據富集美國電話號碼線索

calleridtest.name: calleridtest
calleridtest.text: calleridtest calleridtest free web-based phone number lookup service providing carrier, line type, and basic geographic information for us and international numbers. no account required. useful as a fast, no-cost preliminary check before using paid apis for enrichment. 免費的網頁電話號碼查詢服務,提供美國和國際號碼的運營商、線路類型及基本地理信息,無需帳號,適合在使用付費 api 前進行快速的初步查詢。 free phone number lookup and caller id verification tool. phone carrier-lookup caller-id phone number format or reported context; coverage varies and labels may be wrong. 號碼格式或回報背景;涵蓋範圍不同,標籤可能有誤。 phone quickly check carrier and type for a phone number without api setup perform a no-cost first-pass phone number triage during investigation verify basic phone number validity before deeper enrichment 在不設定 api 的情況下,快速檢查電話號碼的電信業者與類型 在調查期間進行無成本的第一階段電話號碼評估分流 在進行更深度的數據富集前驗證基本電話號碼的有效性

suncalc.name: suncalc
suncalc.text: suncalc suncalc interactive map-based sun position calculator that shows sun azimuth and elevation angle for any location and time of day. investigators use it to geolocate images by matching shadow angles and directions in photographs against suncalc predictions, narrowing possible capture locations and times. 互動式地圖太陽位置計算器,顯示任意地點和時刻的太陽方位角和仰角。調查人員使用它通過匹配照片中的陰影角度和方向與 suncalc 預測,縮小拍攝地點和時間範圍。 sun position calculator for geolocating images by shadow angle. geolocation image-verification shadow-analysis open-source location map, imagery or location clues; check capture date and multiple landmarks. 地圖、影像或地點線索;核對拍攝日期與多個地標。 image geolocation narrow down an image capture location by matching shadow angles to sun position predictions verify whether a photo's claimed timestamp is consistent with shadows and lighting support geolocation analysis by eliminating locations where sun angle is inconsistent 透過比對陰影角度與太陽位置預測,縮小影像拍攝位置的範圍 驗證相片聲稱的時間戳記是否與陰影及光線一致 透過排除太陽角度不一致的位置,來支持地理定位分析

mapillary.name: mapillary
mapillary.text: mapillary mapillary crowdsourced street-level imagery platform (owned by meta) with billions of geotagged photos from around the world. useful for geolocating images against street-level views in areas not covered by google street view, identifying landmarks, signage, vegetation, and infrastructure in location verification workflows. meta 旗下的眾包街景影像平台,擁有來自全球各地數十億張地理標記照片,可在谷歌街景未覆蓋的地區進行圖像地理位置驗證,識別地標、標牌、植被和基礎設施。 crowdsourced street-level imagery platform. geolocation street-view image-verification crowdsourced location map, imagery or location clues; check capture date and multiple landmarks. 地圖、影像或地點線索;核對拍攝日期與多個地標。 image geolocation cross-reference an image with street-level photos from areas not in google street view verify location details by matching architectural and signage details in geotagged photos access historical street-level imagery to track changes in a specific location 將圖片與非 google 街景服務區域的街景相片進行交叉比對 透過比對附有地理標記相片中的建築與標誌細節,驗證位置詳情 存取歷史街景影像以追蹤特定位置的變更

sentinel-hub.name: sentinel hub
sentinel-hub.text: sentinel hub sentinel-hub cloud platform for accessing and processing european space agency sentinel satellite imagery — including optical, sar, and multispectral data. free eo browser allows investigators to access historical satellite imagery, monitor changes over time, and detect large-scale events like fires, floods, or infrastructure changes for geolocation and verification. 訪問和處理歐洲航天局哨兵衛星影像的雲端平台,涵蓋光學、sar 和多光譜數據。免費的 eo browser 允許調查人員訪問歷史衛星影像、監測隨時間的變化及偵測大規模事件。 satellite imagery processing platform from esa sentinel constellation. geolocation satellite-imagery remote-sensing open-source location map, imagery or location clues; check capture date and multiple landmarks. 地圖、影像或地點線索;核對拍攝日期與多個地標。 geolocation image verify whether a claimed explosion, fire, or infrastructure event is visible in satellite imagery access historical imagery to track changes in a target location over months or years use sar imagery to detect activity in areas covered by clouds or at night 驗證衛星影像中是否可見所聲稱的爆炸、火災或基礎設施事件 存取歷史影像以追蹤目標位置在數月或數年期間的變更 使用 sar 影像探測雲層覆蓋區域或夜間的活動

overpass-turbo.name: overpass turbo
overpass-turbo.text: overpass turbo overpass-turbo web-based query interface for extracting data from openstreetmap using the overpass api query language. allows investigators to query specific map features — shops, hospitals, towers, barriers — and export them as geojson for cross-referencing with images. useful for identifying unique infrastructure visible in verification images. 使用 overpass api 查詢語言從 openstreetmap 提取數據的網頁查詢介面,允許調查人員查詢特定地圖特徵(商店、醫院、塔台、路障等)並導出為 geojson 進行交叉比對。 web-based openstreetmap data querying tool. geolocation openstreetmap mapping open-source location map, imagery or location clues; check capture date and multiple landmarks. 地圖、影像或地點線索;核對拍攝日期與多個地標。 geolocation query all bus stops or mosques in a geographic area to narrow down an image location extract specific infrastructure types from osm data for geolocation cross-referencing export geographic features as geojson for integration with mapping analysis tools 查詢地理區域內的所有公車站或清真寺,以縮小影像位置範圍 從 osm 數據中提取特定基礎設施類型以進行地理定位交叉比對 匯出地理特徵為 geojson,以整合至地圖分析工具中

blockchain-explorer.name: blockchain.com explorer
blockchain-explorer.text: blockchain.com explorer blockchain-explorer blockchain.com's public explorer provides free lookup of bitcoin and ethereum addresses, transactions, and block data with no account required. displays address balance, transaction history, and linked addresses. a reliable first-pass tool for confirming wallet activity before moving to more specialized analytics. blockchain.com 的公開瀏覽器免費提供比特幣和以太坊地址、交易及區塊數據查詢,無需帳號。顯示地址餘額、交易歷史及關聯地址,是進行更深入分析前的可靠初步核查工具。 bitcoin and ethereum blockchain explorer by blockchain.com. cryptocurrency bitcoin ethereum blockchain explorer crypto network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 cryptocurrency look up a bitcoin address to retrieve its full transaction history and current balance verify whether a specific transaction hash has been confirmed on the network enumerate all addresses that have transacted with a wallet under investigation 查詢比特幣地址以檢索其完整交易歷史與當前餘額 驗證網路上是否已確認特定的交易雜湊值 列舉所有曾與接受調查的錢包進行交易的地址

etherscan.name: etherscan
etherscan.text: etherscan etherscan the primary public block explorer for the ethereum network. allows lookup of eth addresses, erc-20/erc-721 token transfers, smart contract interactions, and gas usage. the 'internal txns' tab reveals contract-to-contract transfers that standard wallet displays hide. free with optional api tier. 以太坊網絡的主要公開區塊瀏覽器,支援 eth 地址、erc-20/erc-721 代幣轉移、智能合約互動及 gas 使用量查詢。「internal txns」標籤可揭示普通錢包介面隱藏的合約間轉帳。免費提供可選 api。 ethereum blockchain explorer and analytics platform. cryptocurrency ethereum blockchain explorer smart-contracts crypto network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 cryptocurrency trace erc-20 token flows through a wallet address to identify exchange deposits and withdrawals inspect smart contract interactions to identify what protocols a wallet has used use the api to batch-query multiple addresses for automated investigation workflows 追蹤流經錢包地址的 erc-20 代幣流,以識別交易所充值與提現 檢查智慧合約互動,以識別錢包曾使用過哪些協議 使用 api 批次查詢多個地址以進行自動化調查工作流程

breadcrumbs.name: breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.text: breadcrumbs breadcrumbs free visual blockchain analytics platform that renders wallet transaction graphs interactively. trace multi-hop fund flows across bitcoin and ethereum, annotate addresses with labels, and share investigation graphs. designed for osint investigators rather than enterprise compliance, with an accessible no-install web interface. 免費的視覺化區塊鏈分析平台,以互動圖形呈現錢包交易關係,可追蹤比特幣和以太坊的多跳資金流向、標注地址標籤並分享調查圖表,專為 osint 調查人員設計,無需安裝。 visual blockchain transaction investigation tool. cryptocurrency blockchain visualization graph investigation crypto network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 cryptocurrency organization visualize fund flow from a suspicious wallet across multiple hops to identify destination exchanges annotate and share a blockchain investigation graph with collaborators identify cluster patterns in a wallet's transaction history to detect mixing or layering 視覺化來自可疑錢包的多跳資金流,以識別目的地交易所 標記並與合作夥伴分享區塊鏈調查圖表 在錢包交易歷史中識別群聚模式,以偵測混幣(mixing)或分層(layering)行為

arkham-intelligence.name: arkham intelligence
arkham-intelligence.text: arkham intelligence arkham-intelligence arkham intelligence maps on-chain addresses to real-world entities — exchanges, funds, protocols, and individuals — using ai-assisted attribution and a community bounty system. free public tier allows address and entity lookups with partial graph access. notable for attributing previously pseudonymous wallets through behavioral analysis and transaction pattern matching. arkham intelligence 透過 ai 輔助歸因和社群懸賞系統,將鏈上地址映射至真實世界實體(交易所、基金、協議和個人)。免費公開層允許地址和實體查詢,以行為分析和交易模式匹配歸因先前匿名的錢包。 on-chain entity attribution and blockchain intelligence platform. cryptocurrency blockchain attribution intelligence entity-labeling crypto network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 cryptocurrency person organization look up an address to see if arkham has attributed it to a known entity such as an exchange or fund trace large transfers between labeled entities to map fund movement at institutional scale use the portfolio view to assess the full holdings and activity of a known wallet cluster 查詢地址以查看 arkham 是否已將其歸屬為已知實體(例如交易所或基金) 追蹤已標記實體之間的大額轉帳,以繪製機構規模的資金流動圖 使用投資組合視角評估已知錢包群組的完整持倉與活動

bubblemaps.name: bubblemaps
bubblemaps.text: bubblemaps bubblemaps bubblemaps visualizes token holder distribution as interactive bubble charts, revealing wallet clusters, insider allocations, and coordinated holding patterns for defi tokens. useful for identifying undisclosed concentrated ownership, team wallet clusters, and wash-trading patterns that are not obvious from raw on-chain data. bubblemaps 以互動氣泡圖呈現代幣持有者分佈,揭示 defi 代幣中的錢包叢集、內部人配額和協調持倉模式,適用於識別未披露的集中持倉、團隊錢包叢集和原始鏈上數據中不易察覺的洗盤模式。 token holder cluster visualization for blockchain tokens. cryptocurrency blockchain visualization token-analysis defi crypto network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 cryptocurrency organization visualize token holder clusters for a defi project to detect undisclosed insider wallets identify coordinated selling patterns across multiple wallets in a token's holder distribution compare holder cluster changes over time to track token distribution manipulation 視覺化 defi 專案的代幣持有者群組,以偵測未揭露的內部人錢包 在代幣持有者分佈中識別跨多個錢包的協同拋售模式 比較持有者群組隨時間的變化,以追蹤代幣分配操控行為

blockchair.name: blockchair
blockchair.text: blockchair blockchair blockchair is a privacy-focused multi-blockchain explorer supporting bitcoin, ethereum, litecoin, cardano, solana, and 15+ other chains in a single interface. offers full-text transaction memo search, address clustering, utxo analysis, and bulk csv export. notably does not sell user search data to analytics firms. blockchair 是注重隱私的多鏈瀏覽器,在單一介面支援比特幣、以太坊、萊特幣、cardano、solana 等 15+ 個鏈,提供全文交易備忘錄搜尋、地址叢集、utxo 分析和批量 csv 導出,且不向分析公司出售用戶搜尋數據。 multi-blockchain explorer and analytics engine. cryptocurrency blockchain explorer multi-chain analytics crypto network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 cryptocurrency search transaction memos across multiple chains to find references to known identifiers export address transaction history as csv for offline analysis or evidence packaging cross-chain investigation: track funds from bitcoin through ethereum to identify bridge usage 在多個區塊鏈上搜尋交易備忘錄,以尋找對已知識別碼的引用 將地址交易歷史匯出為 csv,以進行離線分析或證據打包 跨鏈調查:追蹤從比特幣到乙太坊的資金以識別跨鏈橋的使用

metasleuth.name: metasleuth
metasleuth.text: metasleuth metasleuth metasleuth by blocksec is a free visual blockchain investigation platform for tracing fund flows, labeling addresses, and sharing investigation reports. supports multi-chain analysis including ethereum, bnb chain, polygon, and others. notable for detecting bridge-crossing transactions that move funds between chains to obscure trails. blocksec 開發的 metasleuth 是免費的視覺化區塊鏈調查平台,用於追蹤資金流向、標記地址和分享調查報告,支援以太坊、bnb chain、polygon 等多鏈分析,尤其擅長偵測跨鏈橋交易以追蹤跨鏈資金轉移痕跡。 blockchain investigation and fund tracking tool by blocksec. cryptocurrency blockchain visualization multi-chain investigation crypto network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 cryptocurrency organization trace multi-chain fund movements to follow assets transferred across bridge protocols generate a shareable investigation report linking wallet addresses to identified entities label custom addresses within an investigation graph and export for evidence documentation 追蹤跨鏈資金流動,以跟隨跨越跨鏈橋協議轉移的資產 生成可分享的調查報告,將錢包地址連結至已識別的實體 在調查圖表中標記自訂地址並匯出以進行證據存檔

oxt.name: oxt
oxt.text: oxt oxt oxt is a free bitcoin-specific blockchain explorer focused on transaction graph analysis and clustering heuristics. implements utxo-based address clustering, coin tracing, and privacy analysis techniques used by researchers. particularly useful for studying bitcoin privacy properties and tracing coinjoins or mixer outputs. oxt 是免費的比特幣專用區塊鏈瀏覽器,專注於交易圖分析和聚類啟發式算法,實現基於 utxo 的地址叢集化、代幣追蹤和研究人員使用的隱私分析技術,尤其適合研究比特幣隱私特性及追蹤 coinjoin 或混幣輸出。 bitcoin transaction graph analysis and privacy research tool. cryptocurrency bitcoin graph clustering privacy-analysis crypto network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 cryptocurrency cluster bitcoin addresses using common-input-ownership heuristics to identify wallet boundaries analyze coinjoin transactions to assess whether effective privacy was achieved study the utxo graph structure of a bitcoin address to identify change outputs 使用共同輸入所有權啟發式方法群聚比特幣地址,以識別錢包邊界 分析 coinjoin 交易以評估是否實現了有效的隱私保護 研究比特幣地址的 utxo 圖結構以識別找零輸出(change outputs)

dune-analytics.name: dune analytics
dune-analytics.text: dune analytics dune-analytics dune analytics allows anyone to query blockchain data using sql, with a vast library of community-published dashboards covering defi protocols, nft markets, and wallet activity. free tier enables query execution and dashboard access. useful for investigators who need custom on-chain queries that go beyond what standard explorers provide. dune analytics 允許任何人使用 sql 查詢區塊鏈數據,擁有涵蓋 defi 協議、nft 市場和錢包活動的大量社群發布儀表板。免費層支援查詢執行和儀表板訪問,適合需要超越標準瀏覽器能力的自定義鏈上查詢的調查人員。 community-driven blockchain analytics platform with sql queries. cryptocurrency blockchain analytics sql defi dashboards crypto network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 cryptocurrency organization run custom sql queries to identify all wallets that interacted with a specific smart contract access community dashboards tracking known exploit addresses or hacker wallet patterns analyze protocol-level fund flows to map money movement through defi applications 執行自訂 sql 查詢以識別所有與特定智慧合約互動的錢包 存取追蹤已知漏洞利用地址或駭客錢包模式的社群儀表板 分析協議級別的資金流,以映射流經 defi 應用程式的資金流動

crystal-intelligence.name: crystal intelligence
crystal-intelligence.text: crystal intelligence crystal-intelligence crystal intelligence provides blockchain transaction monitoring, risk scoring, and entity attribution across bitcoin, ethereum, and 100+ assets. free account offers limited lookups and risk score checks. primarily used by compliance teams but accessible enough for investigators who need to check an address's risk profile against known hacking, darknet, and ransomware entities. crystal intelligence 提供比特幣、以太坊及 100+ 種資產的區塊鏈交易監控、風險評分和實體歸因。免費帳號提供有限查詢和風險評分核查,主要用於合規團隊,也適合需要對照已知駭客、暗網和勒索軟體實體核查地址風險檔案的調查人員。 blockchain analytics and compliance intelligence platform. cryptocurrency blockchain risk-scoring compliance attribution crypto network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 cryptocurrency organization check whether a wallet address has exposure to known darknet markets or sanctioned entities obtain a risk score for a bitcoin address before accepting a payment identify the source of funds for a wallet through automated risk categorization 檢查錢包地址是否曾暴露於已知的暗網市場或受制裁實體中 在接受付款前獲取比特幣地址的風險評估分數 透過自動化風險分類識別錢包的資金來源

chainalysis-reactor.name: chainalysis reactor
chainalysis-reactor.text: chainalysis reactor chainalysis-reactor network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 enterprise blockchain investigation and transaction tracing platform. cryptocurrency blockchain attribution enterprise law-enforcement crypto network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 cryptocurrency person organization conduct court-admissible blockchain tracing with full audit trail for law enforcement use access proprietary exchange attribution data to identify where illicit funds were cashed out generate regulatory compliance reports linking transaction clusters to real-world entities 進行符合法庭證據標準的區塊鏈追蹤,並為執法用途提供完整審計軌跡 存取專有的交易所歸屬數據,以識別非法資金在何處提現 生成將交易群組連結至現實世界實體的法規合規報告

hyperbot-network.name: hyperbot
hyperbot-network.text: hyperbot hyperbot-network hyperbot is an ai-powered on-chain intelligence platform focused on hyperliquid and aster perpetual dexs. it provides whale tracking, smart money identification, and pnl curve analysis across 600,000+ hyperliquid addresses using natural language queries and ai tagging. useful for investigators tracing large-position holders, attributing wallet clusters, and monitoring coordinated trading behavior on decentralized perpetual exchanges. hyperbot 是以 ai 驅動的鏈上情報平台,專注於 hyperliquid 與 aster 永續 dex,透過自然語言查詢與 ai 標籤追蹤逾 60 萬個 hyperliquid 地址的巨鯨動向、聰明錢識別與損益曲線分析,適用於追蹤大倉位持有者、歸因錢包叢集及監控協調交易行為。 ai-powered on-chain intelligence for hyperliquid perpetual dex. cryptocurrency blockchain defi whale-tracking behavioral-analysis crypto network-specific public transaction or attribution leads, not proven real identities. 特定鏈的公開交易或歸屬線索,並非已證實的真實身份。 cryptocurrency person organization identify top pnl wallets on hyperliquid to attribute coordinated market activity to known entities monitor whale address movements and alert patterns for on-chain behavioral profiling cross-reference large trader addresses across dex leaderboards to build a trader identity graph 識別 hyperliquid 上收益最高(pnl)的錢包,將協同的市場活動歸因於已知實體 監控巨鯨地址動向和警報模式以進行鏈上行為分析 交叉比對 dex 排行榜上的大額交易者地址,以建立交易者身分圖譜

flightradar24.name: flightradar24
flightradar24.text: flightradar24 flightradar24 flightradar24 aggregates ads-b, mlat, and faa data to display real-time and historical positions for 180,000+ flights per day worldwide. free tier shows current positions and basic flight data. investigators use it to verify aircraft movements, track tail numbers, identify routes for a specific aircraft, and cross-reference with ground events. flightradar24 聚合 ads-b、mlat 和 faa 數據,每日即時顯示全球逾 18 萬架次航班的位置。免費層提供當前位置和基本航班數據,調查人員可用它核實飛機動向、追蹤尾號、識別特定飛機的航線並與地面事件交叉比對。 real-time ads-b aircraft tracking platform. adsb aircraft aviation tracking geolocation sigint aircraft aircraft or flight observations; receiver coverage and timestamps limit interpretation. 航空器或航班觀察;接收涵蓋範圍與時間會影響判讀。 network geolocation organization track the real-time position and route of an aircraft by registration or flight number review historical flight paths for a specific tail number to establish movement patterns verify whether a private aircraft was present at a specific location during an event 按註冊號或航班號追蹤飛機的即時位置與航線 審查特定機尾號的歷史飛行路徑以建立活動模式 驗證在特定事件期間私人飛機是否曾出現在該地點

adsbexchange.name: ads-b exchange
adsbexchange.text: ads-b exchange adsbexchange ads-b exchange is a community-run ads-b aggregator that does not comply with government or corporate requests to remove or block aircraft from its feed — unlike flightradar24. this makes it the preferred source for tracking military, law enforcement, and government aircraft that commercial platforms occasionally suppress. free data access via web and api. ads-b exchange 是社群運營的 ads-b 聚合器,不遵從政府或企業的移除/屏蔽飛機請求,有別於 flightradar24,是追蹤偶爾被商業平台壓制的軍用、執法和政府飛機的首選來源,免費提供網頁和 api 數據訪問。 unfiltered community ads-b flight tracking without government request compliance. adsb aircraft aviation sigint unfiltered military aircraft aircraft or flight observations; receiver coverage and timestamps limit interpretation. 航空器或航班觀察;接收涵蓋範圍與時間會影響判讀。 network geolocation organization track military or government aircraft that are hidden or suppressed on commercial ads-b platforms access unfiltered flight data via api for automated aircraft monitoring workflows verify historical aircraft positions when a commercial platform has removed the track 追蹤在商業 ads-b 平台上被隱藏或壓制的軍用或政府飛機 透過 api 存取未經過濾的飛行數據,以進行自動化飛機監控工作流程 當商業平台移除軌跡時,驗證歷史飛機位置

marinetraffic.name: marinetraffic
marinetraffic.text: marinetraffic marinetraffic marinetraffic is the leading public ais vessel tracking platform, displaying real-time and historical positions for ships worldwide using automatic identification system (ais) radio broadcasts. free tier provides current vessel positions and basic voyage data. used by investigators to track ship movements, verify port calls, and identify flag-of-convenience vessels. marinetraffic 是領先的公開 ais 船舶追蹤平台,利用自動識別系統(ais)無線電廣播顯示全球船舶的即時和歷史位置。免費層提供當前船舶位置和基本航次數據,用於追蹤船舶動向、核實靠港情況和識別方便旗船舶。 ais vessel tracking and maritime intelligence platform. ais maritime vessel tracking geolocation rf sigint vessel vessel observations; identifiers and observation times need verification. 船舶觀察;需核對識別碼與觀察時間。 network geolocation organization track a vessel's current position and review its historical voyage route and port calls identify all vessels registered under a specific flag state or operating company verify whether a ship was in a specific location during a reported maritime incident 追蹤船隻的當前位置,並審查其歷史航線與港口停靠記錄 識別在特定船旗國或營運公司下註冊的所有船隻 驗證在通報的海事事故期間,船隻是否位於特定位置

opensky-network.name: opensky network
opensky-network.text: opensky network opensky-network opensky network is a non-profit ads-b aggregation network operated by academic institutions, offering free historical flight data download for research purposes. unlike commercial platforms, it provides access to raw ads-b records for specific time windows and geographic regions. valuable when you need historical aircraft data that commercial platforms restrict behind paywalls. opensky network 是由學術機構運營的非營利 ads-b 聚合網絡,免費提供用於研究目的的歷史飛行數據下載,提供特定時間窗口和地理區域的原始 ads-b 記錄,在商業平台將歷史數據鎖在付費牆後尤為有價值。 open academic ads-b network providing historical flight data. adsb aircraft aviation sigint open-data historical aircraft aircraft or flight observations; receiver coverage and timestamps limit interpretation. 航空器或航班觀察;接收涵蓋範圍與時間會影響判讀。 network geolocation download historical ads-b records for a geographic region during a specific time window access raw flight data for investigative analysis without commercial platform restrictions cross-reference aircraft tracks from different data sources to verify position accuracy 下載特定時間窗口內某一地理區域的歷史 ads-b 記錄 獲取用於調查分析的原始飛行數據,而不受商業平台限制 交叉比對來自不同數據源的飛機軌跡以驗證位置準確性

websdr.name: websdr
websdr.text: websdr websdr websdr hosts a network of publicly accessible software defined radio (sdr) receivers connected to the internet, allowing anyone to tune and listen to radio frequencies worldwide through a web browser without any hardware. useful for monitoring public shortwave broadcasts, amateur radio activity, and hf signals from specific geographic regions. websdr 托管一個可通過網絡訪問的軟件定義無線電(sdr)接收器網絡,允許任何人在不需要任何硬件的情況下通過網絡瀏覽器調諧和收聽全球無線電頻率,適用於監聽特定地理區域的公共短波廣播、業餘無線電活動和 hf 信號。 network of web-accessible software-defined radio receivers. sdr rf radio spectrum shortwave monitoring radio_signal radio reference material or received signals; interpretation requires technical context. 無線電參考資料或接收訊號;判讀需要技術背景。 network geolocation listen to public shortwave broadcasts or amateur radio from a specific geographic region monitor hf frequencies used for known public emergency or maritime communications verify whether a specific frequency is being used in a target area without local hardware 收聽來自特定地理區域的公開短波廣播或業餘無線電 監控用於已知公共緊急或海事通訊的高頻(hf)頻率 在沒有本地硬體的情況下,驗證特定頻率是否正在目標區域中使用

sigidwiki.name: signal identification wiki
sigidwiki.text: signal identification wiki sigidwiki signal identification wiki is a community-maintained reference database of radio signal types with audio samples, waterfall images, and technical parameters. used by investigators and radio operators to identify an unknown signal's origin, modulation, and likely purpose. covers military, commercial, maritime, and amateur signal types. signal identification wiki 是社群維護的無線電信號類型參考資料庫,包含音頻樣本、瀑布圖和技術參數,供調查人員和無線電操作員識別未知信號的來源、調制方式和可能用途,涵蓋軍用、商用、海事和業餘信號類型。 community wiki for identifying unknown radio signals. rf sigint signal-identification spectrum radio radio_signal radio reference material or received signals; interpretation requires technical context. 無線電參考資料或接收訊號;判讀需要技術背景。 network identify an unknown radio signal by comparing its waterfall pattern to the signal database determine the modulation type and likely use case of a signal recorded during monitoring research which agencies or services typically use a specific frequency band and signal type 透過比對其瀑布圖模式與信號資料庫,識別未知的無線電信號 確定監控期間記錄的信號調變類型與可能的使用情境 研究哪些機構或服務通常使用特定的頻段和信號類型

radioreference.name: radioreference
radioreference.text: radioreference radioreference radioreference is the world's largest radio frequency database, covering police, fire, ems, federal, and military trunked radio systems across the us and internationally. free tier provides frequency lookups by location, agency, or system. used by investigators to identify what public-safety agencies are operating in a specific area and what frequencies they use. radioreference 是全球最大的無線電頻率資料庫,涵蓋美國及國際的警察、消防、急救、聯邦和軍用集群無線電系統。免費層提供按地點、機構或系統的頻率查詢,供調查人員識別特定區域的公共安全機構及其使用頻率。 comprehensive radio frequency and trunked system database. rf radio frequency-database public-safety sigint radio_signal radio reference material or received signals; interpretation requires technical context. 無線電參考資料或接收訊號;判讀需要技術背景。 network organization look up all public-safety radio frequencies operating in a specific city or county identify the trunked radio system used by a law enforcement agency for monitoring authorization research federal agency radio systems operating in a target geographic area 查詢在特定城市或郡運作的所有公共安全無線電頻率 識別執法機構使用的集群無線電系統以進行監控授權 研究在目標地理區域內運作的聯邦機構無線電系統

liveatc.name: liveatc
liveatc.text: liveatc liveatc liveatc streams live and archived air traffic control (atc) radio communications from airports worldwide, contributed by volunteer feeders. coverage spans 2,000+ airports across 150+ countries. investigators and journalists use it to verify reported aircraft incidents, listen to communications during known events, and access archived feeds for specific dates. liveatc 從全球 150+ 國家、2,000+ 機場直播和存檔空中交通管制(atc)無線電通訊,由志願者供稿。調查人員和記者使用它核實報告的飛機事故、監聽已知事件中的通訊,並訪問特定日期的存檔供料。 live and archived air traffic control audio feeds worldwide. rf aviation atc radio monitoring sigint radio_signal radio reference material or received signals; interpretation requires technical context. 無線電參考資料或接收訊號;判讀需要技術背景。 network geolocation listen to atc communications at a specific airport during a reported aviation incident access archived atc audio to verify what was communicated during a specific event monitor active airport frequencies to track unusual aircraft activity in real time 在通報的航空事故期間,收聽特定機場的航管(atc)通訊 存取封存的航管音訊,以驗證在特定事件期間溝通了哪些內容 監控活躍的機場頻率,以即時追蹤異常的飛機活動

vesselfinder.name: vesselfinder
vesselfinder.text: vesselfinder vesselfinder vesselfinder is an ais maritime tracking platform providing real-time ship positions, vessel particulars, and voyage history. useful as a cross-reference source alongside marinetraffic, as different platforms receive ais from different ground station networks and may show vessels the other misses. free tier covers current positions and basic vessel data. vesselfinder 是提供即時船舶位置、船舶詳情和航次歷史的 ais 海事追蹤平台,可與 marinetraffic 交叉比對,因不同平台從不同地面站網絡接收 ais,可能顯示對方遺漏的船舶。免費層涵蓋當前位置和基本船舶數據。 ais vessel tracking platform with historical voyage data. ais maritime vessel tracking rf geolocation vessel vessel observations; identifiers and observation times need verification. 船舶觀察;需核對識別碼與觀察時間。 network geolocation organization cross-reference a vessel's position with marinetraffic to verify ais reporting consistency look up vessel registration details, imo number, and flag state for a ship under investigation track port arrivals and departures to build a vessel's recent activity timeline 將船隻位置與 marinetraffic 進行交叉比對,以驗證 ais 通報的一致性 查詢接受調查的船隻之船舶註冊詳情、imo 編號和船旗國 追蹤港口抵達與出發情況,以建立船隻近期的活動時間軸

airframes-io.name: airframes
airframes-io.text: airframes airframes-io airframes decodes and archives acars (aircraft communications addressing and reporting system) and vdl mode 2 data link messages broadcast by commercial aircraft. these messages contain flight plan updates, weather reports, maintenance notifications, and position reports. provides operational intelligence beyond ads-b, including engine performance data and pre-departure clearances. airframes 解碼並存檔商業飛機廣播的 acars 和 vdl mode 2 數據鏈信息,包含飛行計劃更新、天氣報告、維護通知和位置報告,提供超越 ads-b 的運營情報,包括發動機性能數據和起飛前許可。 acars and vdl aircraft data link message decoder and archive. adsb acars aircraft sigint aviation rf aircraft aircraft or flight observations; receiver coverage and timestamps limit interpretation. 航空器或航班觀察;接收涵蓋範圍與時間會影響判讀。 network geolocation organization access acars message history for a specific tail number to review operational communications decode pre-departure clearance messages to see filed flight plans before departure monitor maintenance and fault messages for aircraft to identify operational anomalies 存取特定機尾號的 acars 訊息歷史以審查運作通訊 解碼起飛前許可訊息以在起飛前查看已申報的飛行計劃 監控飛機的維護和故障訊息以識別運作異常

zoomeye.name: zoomeye
zoomeye.text: zoomeye zoomeye zoomeye by knownsec is a chinese-developed cyberspace search engine that indexes internet-facing devices and services, including industrial control systems, webcams, and network appliances. particularly effective for discovering devices in asia-pacific regions that shodan and censys may undercount. free tier allows limited queries. supports dork-style search syntax. 知道創宇開發的 zoomeye 是中國自主研發的網絡空間搜尋引擎,索引網絡連接設備和服務,包括工業控制系統、攝影機和網絡設備,尤其擅長發現 shodan 和 censys 可能低估的亞太地區設備。免費層允許有限查詢,支援 dork 式搜尋語法。 chinese cyberspace search engine for internet-connected devices. iot-osint device-search cyberspace-mapping network-scanning ip website indexed service observations that may be historical. 已索引的服務觀察,可能是歷史資料。 ip network domain search for exposed devices in a specific asia-pacific ip range not well-covered by shodan use zoomeye dork syntax to find a specific device type or firmware version globally cross-reference a device fingerprint with zoomeye to verify geographic distribution 在 shodan 未能良好覆蓋的特定亞太地區 ip 範圍內搜尋暴露的裝置 使用 zoomeye dork 語法在全球範圍內尋找特定的裝置類型或韌體版本 將裝置指紋與 zoomeye 進行交叉比對以驗證地理分佈

fofa.name: fofa
fofa.text: fofa fofa fofa is a cyberspace mapping and intelligence platform developed by baimaohui security research center. it indexes internet-facing services with detailed fingerprinting, supporting searches by domain, ip, certificate, banner, and product keyword. often surfaces devices and services in china and southeast asia not found in western-operated scanners. fofa 是白帽匯安全研究中心開發的網絡空間測繪和情報平台,對網絡連接服務進行詳細指紋識別,支援按域名、ip、憑證、橫幅和產品關鍵字搜尋,常發現西方掃描器未收錄的中國和東南亞設備和服務。 chinese cyberspace asset mapping and threat intelligence platform. iot-osint cyberspace-mapping device-search fingerprinting ip website indexed service observations that may be historical. 已索引的服務觀察,可能是歷史資料。 ip network domain search for exposed services in china or southeast asia using certificate or banner fingerprints identify the geographic spread of a specific iot device model across different countries find internet-exposed instances of specific industrial software or control panel versions 利用憑證或橫幅(banner)指紋搜尋中國或東南亞暴露的服務 識別特定 iot 裝置型號在不同國家的地理分佈情況 尋找特定工業軟體或控制面板版本暴露於網際網路的實例

binaryedge.name: binaryedge
binaryedge.text: binaryedge binaryedge binaryedge continuously scans the internet to map attack surfaces, identify exposed iot devices, and detect misconfigured services. provides structured data on open ports, protocols, certificates, and service banners. free tier offers limited queries. its tormentor scoring system highlights the most critical exposures for triage prioritization. binaryedge 持續掃描互聯網以繪製攻擊面、識別暴露的 iot 設備和偵測錯誤配置的服務,提供關於開放端口、協議、憑證和服務橫幅的結構化數據。免費層提供有限查詢,其 tormentor 評分系統突出顯示最關鍵的暴露以供分類優先處理。 internet-wide scan platform for attack surface and iot exposure monitoring. iot-osint attack-surface smart-devices network-scanning exposure ip website indexed service observations that may be historical. 已索引的服務觀察,可能是歷史資料。 ip network domain organization identify all internet-exposed services for a target organization's ip range detect misconfigured databases, storage buckets, or management interfaces in an ip block monitor attack surface changes over time for a specific domain or organization 識別目標組織 ip 範圍內所有暴露於網際網路的服務 在 ip 區段中偵測配置錯誤的資料庫、儲存桶或管理介面 監控特定網域或組織的攻擊面隨時間的變更

onyphe.name: onyphe
onyphe.text: onyphe onyphe onyphe is a european cyber threat intelligence search engine that collects data from internet scans, honeypots, dark web crawls, and threat feeds. unlike shodan, it combines passive dns, whois, and threat intelligence data in a single query interface. free tier available. used for holistic assessment of an ip or domain across multiple data sources simultaneously. onyphe 是歐洲網絡威脅情報搜尋引擎,從互聯網掃描、蜜罐、暗網爬取和威脅供料收集數據,與 shodan 不同,它在單一查詢介面中結合被動 dns、whois 和威脅情報數據。提供免費層,用於跨多個數據源同時全面評估 ip 或域名。 french cyber defense search engine for internet-facing infrastructure. iot-osint cyber-defense device-search threat-intelligence passive-dns ip website indexed service observations that may be historical. 已索引的服務觀察,可能是歷史資料。 ip network domain query an ip address to see its combined scan data, threat intelligence, and passive dns records find internet-exposed services that have appeared in honeypot logs or threat feeds assess an organization's attack surface with a multi-source view not available in single-source scanners 查詢 ip 地址以查看其合併的掃描數據、威脅情報與被動 dns 記錄 尋找曾出現在蜜罐(honeypot)日誌或威脅來源中的網際網路暴露服務 利用單一來源掃描器無法提供的多源檢視評估組織的攻擊面

leakix.name: leakix
leakix.text: leakix leakix leakix specializes in identifying publicly exposed services that are misconfigured or leaking data — including open mongodb databases, exposed elasticsearch clusters, unprotected s3-compatible storage, and insecure iot management interfaces. data is collected passively and displayed with severity classifications. free for researchers and security professionals. leakix 專注於識別配置錯誤或洩露數據的公開暴露服務,包括開放的 mongodb 資料庫、暴露的 elasticsearch 集群、未受保護的 s3 兼容存儲和不安全的 iot 管理介面,被動收集數據並按嚴重性分類顯示,供研究人員和安全專業人員免費使用。 internet scanner focused on exposed and misconfigured services. iot-osint exposed-services misconfiguration data-exposure smart-devices ip website indexed service observations that may be historical. 已索引的服務觀察,可能是歷史資料。 ip network domain search for exposed databases or storage buckets associated with a target domain or ip range identify publicly visible iot management consoles or admin panels in a target organization's infrastructure check whether a specific technology stack has known misconfiguration patterns visible at an ip 搜尋與目標網域或 ip 範圍關聯的暴露資料庫或儲存桶 在目標組織的基礎設施中識別公開可見的 iot 管理主控台或管理面板 檢查特定的技術棧在某個 ip 上是否有可見的已知配置錯誤模式

criminalip.name: criminal ip
criminalip.text: criminal ip criminalip criminal ip is a cyber threat intelligence search engine that continuously scans the internet and assigns ai-driven risk scores to ip addresses, domains, and exposed services. features domain and certificate search, port scan history, and a vulnerability mapping layer. free tier available. particularly strong for identifying high-risk iot and ot device exposures. criminal ip 是持續掃描互聯網並對 ip 地址、域名和暴露服務賦予 ai 驅動風險評分的網絡威脅情報搜尋引擎,具有域名和憑證搜尋、端口掃描歷史和漏洞映射層,免費層可用,尤其擅長識別高風險 iot 和 ot 設備暴露。 attack surface intelligence engine with ai-powered threat scoring. iot-osint attack-surface device-intelligence smart-devices risk-scoring ip website indexed service observations that may be historical. 已索引的服務觀察,可能是歷史資料。 ip network domain obtain an ai risk score for an ip address to quickly triage its threat level search for exposed iot device types by banner or certificate fingerprint with risk scoring review port scan history for an ip to identify recently opened or closed services 獲取 ip 地址的 ai 風險評估分數,以快速分流其威脅級別 透過橫幅或憑證指紋搜尋暴露的 iot 裝置類型並進行風險評分 審查 ip 的通訊埠掃描歷史以識別近期開啟或關閉的服務

fullhunt.name: fullhunt
fullhunt.text: fullhunt fullhunt fullhunt maps an organization's entire internet-exposed attack surface — domains, subdomains, ip ranges, and associated open ports and services — from a single domain or company name query. free tier covers basic asset discovery. useful for building a complete picture of an organization's iot and web-facing infrastructure exposure before investigation. fullhunt 從單個域名或公司名稱查詢映射組織的整個互聯網暴露攻擊面,包括域名、子域名、ip 範圍及關聯的開放端口和服務。免費層涵蓋基本資產發現,適用於在調查前建立組織 iot 和面向網絡的基礎設施暴露的完整圖景。 attack surface discovery and monitoring platform. iot-osint attack-surface asset-discovery subdomain-enumeration ip website indexed service observations that may be historical. 已索引的服務觀察,可能是歷史資料。 domain ip network organization enumerate all internet-exposed assets for a target organization from a single domain query identify subdomains and associated infrastructure that a company may not be aware of monitor attack surface changes for an organization over time to detect new exposures 透過單一網域查詢,列舉目標組織的所有網際網路暴露資產 識別公司可能未察覺的子網域與關聯基礎設施 監控組織的攻擊面變化,以偵測新的安全暴露

publicwww.name: publicwww
publicwww.text: publicwww publicwww publicwww indexes the source code of billions of websites, allowing search by html snippet, javascript library, meta tag, tracking id, or technology fingerprint. useful for finding iot device web management interfaces that expose version strings or default page titles, identifying all websites using a specific technology, or tracking malicious code distribution. publicwww 索引數十億個網站的源代碼,允許按 html 片段、javascript 庫、meta 標籤、追蹤 id 或技術指紋搜尋,可用於查找暴露版本字符串或默認頁面標題的 iot 設備網絡管理界面、識別使用特定技術的所有網站或追蹤惡意代碼分佈。 source code and digital fingerprint search engine for websites. iot-osint source-code-search fingerprinting web-intelligence website observed website technologies or indexed code matches. 網站技術觀察或已索引的程式碼匹配。 domain network search for all websites exposing a specific iot device admin panel by its default page title find all sites using a specific javascript tracking id to map an entity's web infrastructure identify websites sharing a specific code snippet to detect malicious injection campaigns 透過預設網頁標題,搜尋所有暴露特定 iot 裝置管理面板的網站 尋找使用特定 javascript 追蹤 id 的所有網站,以映射實體的網站基礎設施 識別共享特定程式碼片段的網站,以偵測惡意植入活動
